articleTitle: The Decision Tree Interference Identification Method Based on Entropy Features
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: To address the challenge of recognizing communication interference signals in low interference-to-noise ratio (INR) environments, this paper proposes a decision tree-based interference recognition method utilizing entropy features. After preprocessing the interference signals and performing Fourier transform, information entropy and median permutation entropy features were introduced based on the frequency domain characteristics. A decision tree classifier is then used to classify and identify the interference signals. The simulation results indicate that when the INR is greater than -2 dB, the overall recognition success rate approaches 100%.

articleTitle: Mamaba-Based Federated Learning for Medical X-Ray Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: Federated learning, as a distributed machine learning paradigm, can effectively solve the data silo problem and protect data privacy from achieving AI collaboration and has been widely used in the medical field in recent years. Since the computational power of each participant may vary significantly, we need to try to reduce the computation cost for clients in Federated Learning, so people have been looking for efficient medical image segmentation models. Previously, the most commonly used models are cnn-based and transformer-based. But CNNs have limitations in modeling long-range dependencies, Transformers suffer from their quadratic computational complexity.Recent research has demonstrated that state-space models (SSMs), such as Mamba, can effectively capture distant relationships while maintaining linear computational complexity. Therefore, we introduce the Visual Mamba model into federated learning and compare its effectiveness with some CNN-based models. We conducted experiments on the CPN X-ray dataset to compare the accuracy of each model under IID conditions and tracked the decreasing loss of each model under different Epochs. Our work aims to demonstrate the effectiveness of the new Mamba model in medical federated learning and provide valuable insights for the development of more powerful SSM AI algorithms in this field.

articleTitle: Noise Impact Suppression for Acoustic Complexity Index
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: The acoustic complexity index (ACI) remains relatively susceptible to noise in practice although it is designed with consideration for suppressing steady noise to a certain extent. This raises concerns about its reliability and overall effectiveness in acoustic ecological monitoring. In this work, a noise-robust strategy of ACI with the new-designed denoising acoustic complexity index (DACI) is introduced to address this issue. This improved version of ACI quantifies the variations of acoustic intensity within the power spectrogram instead of the magnitude one after a spectral subtraction based denoising procedure, such that it is more capable of capturing the intrinsic statistical features of biological communities in real-world soundscapes than ACI. Experimental results indicate that DACI maintains high numerical stability even at a low signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) of -20 dB and has a strong correlation with ACI under high SNR conditions. Consequently, this processing strategy is able to significantly extend the spatiotemporal application areas of noise-robust ACI variants without affecting the existing ecological interpretations and research accumulations of ACI.

articleTitle: An Improved Nearest Neighbor Algorithm Based on Trajectory-Oriented Estimation
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: In the multi-target tracking scenario, the nearest neighbor(NN) algorithm is the most commonly used method in the track association stage. By setting the tracking gate, the initial screening of the echoes obtained is performed to select candidate echoes, which limits the number of echoes participating in the correlation judgment. The setting of the gate affects the selection of candidate echoes, but in the multi-echo environment, the candidate echoes may not be real echoes, and it is easy to have false tracking and lose the target. This paper improves this process by using the trajectory-oriented estimation (TOE) method to set the correlation gate, thus ensuring the accuracy of the gate setting and improving the tracking performance of the nearest neighbor algorithm. The simulation results verify the performance of the algorithm, and compared with the traditional nearest neighbor algorithm, the algorithm can effectively improve the accuracy of multi-target tracking.

articleTitle: 3D Finite Element Numerical Simulation Analysis of Conical Indenters Indentation Test
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: According to Indentation hardness testing theory, a three-dimensional finite element numerical simulation model of Rockwell hardness is proposed. Based on ANSYS. The stress development rule and residual stress distribution of the materials during loading and unloading are obtained. The results of load-displacement curve of Oliver-charr analysis are consistent with the characteristics of this finite element model. The uncertain propagation coefficient between the geometric size deviation and the hardness value was calculated by linear regression analysis.

articleTitle: Mobile Robot Path Planning Based on Optimized TD3 Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: This paper explores the core issues of path planning for mobile unmanned robots and evaluates the performance of three path planning algorithms based on deep reinforcement learning (TD3, Opt_TD3, Opt_TD3+LSTM) in different simulation environments. Experimental results show that the traditional TD3 algorithm tends to get stuck in local optima, while the Opt_TD3, which incorporates obstacle avoidance modules and heuristic functions, shows improvements but lacks stability. In contrast, the Opt_TD3+LSTM algorithm, which integrates LSTM, demonstrates superior performance in terms of policy selection and stability, effectively adapting to complex environments.

articleTitle: WG-Net: Dual Stream Network with Classifier for Image Manipulation
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: The swift progression of image editing software and algorithms has facilitated the proliferation of practices like copying, pasting, and removing during image manipulation. Consequently, there has been a notable surge in instances of image tampering. In response, there has been rapid progress in the development of methodologies aimed at detecting and locating such tampering, thereby safeguarding the integrity of images and upholding the credibility and authenticity of information. Henceforth, we introduce WG-Net, a dual-stream network integrated with a classifier designed to detect and locate manipulated images. WG-Net consists of three primary elements: the classifier, CNN stream, and Transformer stream. Within the classifier, we employ MobileNetV3 as our classification network to discern tampered images, advancing to subsequent steps upon detecting such alterations. The CNN stream and Transformer stream are both employed in the extraction of image features, with the latter specifically utilized for constructing comprehensive global information. This facilitates the attainment of substantial global receptive fields, even with a comparatively shallow network depth. Furthermore, we have innovated a feature fusion module named Qcfusion to amalgamate features derived from both branches. Results obtained from extensive experimentation across various datasets unequivocally showcase the superiority of our network over contemporary methods in terms of both tampering detection and localization.

articleTitle: Design and Verification of IEEE 802.1AS Time Synchronization System
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: High precision Time synchronization protocols have been a key challenge for time Sensitive networks (TSN). As the core of TSN technology, the IEEE 802.1AS time synchronization protocol ensures that the terminal and bridge devices in the TSN network have the same time reference. Based on the in-depth analysis of the influencing factors of the time synchronization protocol, a new method of hardware and software co-design based on Xilinx Zynq 7000 series FPGA platform is proposed. The method of hardware marking time stamp is adopted to avoid the uncertainty caused by protocol stack and operating system. The time synchronization accuracy is stable within ±40ns after single hop and multi-hop test. This scheme provides a low-cost, simple and reliable time synchronization solution with superior performance for highly sensitive applications. such as airborne aircraft.

articleTitle: Front-End Readout ASIC Design for Neutron Detectors
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: The traditional detector readout electronics take up a large amount of space and consume high power, limiting the system's integration level and not meeting the requirements of new types of detectors. To meet the demand for high-efficiency, high-resolution neutron detectors, an ASIC chip based on GF 0.13μm CMOS technology has been designed. This chip adopts a mixed-signal design and integrates 32 channels on a single chip. It mainly includes a charge-sensitive amplifier (CSA), shaping-filter circuit (CR-RC), calibration signal configuration circuit, and decoder circuit. Test results show that the chip has low power consumption, relatively good channel consistency, excellent linearity in the range of 0-100fC, and a maximum counting rate of up to 2MHz.

articleTitle: Research on Puncture Path Planning and Control of Hemodialysis Fistula Robot
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: The hemodialysis arteriovenous fistula puncture robot is a new type of auxiliary medical robot applied in the field of hemodialysis. The planning of the puncture path is an important factor in controlling the robot to achieve precise puncture. During the execution of automatic puncture in hemodialysis, planning the puncture surgery in advance and determining a reasonable and safe path are of significant importance for improving the puncture accuracy and efficiency of the fistula puncture robot. In this study, a hemodialysis arteriovenous fistula puncture robot system was developed, and the fistula puncture path planning and spatial motion analysis were carried out, resulting in an optimal path evaluation equation for the puncture needle; through the simulation testing of fistula puncture needle planning, the robot's end puncture was able to reach the estimated range. Experimental analysis concluded that the venous prosthetic arm fistula puncture under visual image guidance, combined with the Rapidly-exploring Random Tree (RRT) algorithm, can effectively solve the problem of fistula puncture path planning and enhance the accuracy of the puncture path planning, demonstrating certain effectiveness and providing a valuable reference for the field of puncture robots.

articleTitle: Real-time Video Target Tracking Algorithm Utilizing Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN)
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: This paper aims to research and implement a real-time video target tracking algorithm based on Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN), enhancing the accuracy and robustness of target tracking in complex scenarios. Addressing the limitations of traditional tracking algorithms in handling issues such as target occlusion, morphological changes, and background interference, our approach integrates target detection and tracking strategies. It continuously updates the target model through an online learning mechanism to adapt to changes in the target's appearance. Experimental results demonstrate that, when dealing with situations involving rapid motion, partial occlusion, and complex backgrounds, the proposed algorithm exhibits higher tracking success rates and lower failure rates compared to several mainstream tracking algorithms. This study successfully applies CNN to real-time video target tracking, improving the accuracy and stability of the tracking algorithm while maintaining high processing speeds, thus meeting the demands of real-time applications. This algorithm is expected to provide new solutions for target tracking tasks in video surveillance and intelligent transportation domains.

articleTitle: Abnormal Intrusion Perception Technology for Power Data Transmission Network Based on Data Mining
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: With the continuous improvement of the informatization level of the power system, the security of the power data transmission network is crucial. This article explores the application of data mining techniques in detecting security risks of abnormal intrusion in power data transmission networks. Firstly, the security challenges faced by the power data transmission network were introduced, and then the principles of data mining technology and its advantages in this field were elaborated. The specific application effects of data mining technology were demonstrated through practical case analysis, and the differences between data mining and traditional models in security risk perception were compared. Finally, the future development prospects were discussed.

articleTitle: PGC-CNN to Achieve Superior Performance in Rotation-Invariant Image Recognition
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: Deep convolutional neural networks are character-ized by translational invariance and sparse connectivity, at-tributes that enable them to obtain powerful feature represen-tations. Compared to traditional methods, CNN-based backbone networks achieve significant performance improvements in image classification tasks. Despite their remarkable success, CNN lack inherent rotational invariance, resulting in a substantial drop in performance when handling target image data with rotational attributes. To address this issue, data augmentation is often employed to randomly enhance the training set from multiple angles and then utilize larger CNN to learn features from different rotation angles of the same target. However, this approach can lead to a large number of parameters. To solve this problem, we present a method that combines CNN with Partial differential equations Group CNN network (PGC) structures. After a target sample is input into the model, it first passes through shallow CNN layers to extract local features, followed by PGC layers with rotational equivariance for feature extraction that maintains rotational properties. Specifically, we do not rely on methods like data augmentation or other regu-larization techniques, which require extensive computations to achieve rotational invariance. Instead, we leverage the inherent rotational feature invariance of the PGC layers. We evaluated our method on public image classification datasets and achieved significant performance improvements compared to traditional convolutional neural network.

articleTitle: A FPGA-Based Accelerator Design for Speaker Verification using 1D-CNN
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: The one-dimensional convolutional neural network (1D-CNN) has been widely used in large-scale speaker voice verification due to its effectiveness. The primary objective of this study is to construct a 1D-CNN model for speaker verification and to design a hardware accelerator on a low-cost hardware platform. We thoroughly analyzed the impact of different parallel parameters on the computational process and proposed a parallelism search method to determine optimal architectural design parameters. Experiments of the proposed 1D-CNN on the FPGA ZYNQ XCZU2CG demonstrated that our 1D-CNN accelerator architecture achieves an overall throughput of 63.67 GOPS at 200MHz with power consumption of only 2.13W, and a DSP efficiency of 0.354 GOP/s/DSP.

articleTitle: Design of Signal Processing System for Pipeline Pig Tracking and Positioning Receiver Based on Orthogonal Digital Lock-in Amplification Principle
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: The current signal processing system of pipeline pig tracking and positioning receiver based on bandpass filter is difficult to ensure high reliability and sensitivity when receiving weak signals from transmitters in complex environments due to limitations of Q value. Meanwhile, the frequency characteristics and overall sensitivity of the signal processing stages within the system are fixed and not adjustable, limiting the system's ability to adapt to different operating modes under varying environmental conditions. This paper presents a signal processing system based on orthogonal digital lock-in amplification principle. The system employs operational amplifier AD821 with low-noise for preamplification, specialized filter chips LTC10696 and LTC1068200 with adjustable frequency characteristics for low-pass filtering and band-pass filtering, then STM32F103RBT6 microcontroller is utilized to perform the A/D conversion and orthogonal digital lockin amplification (DLIA) processing. The system can reliably receive the 23 Hz sinusoidal signal from the transmitter with ultrahigh sensitivity, and its frequency characteristic and receiving sensitivity can be flexibly adjusted through programming. Experiment shows that the system can meet the diversified demands for detection sensitivity under different environmental conditions, with effective receiving sensitivity (up to 40 m in the highest sensitivity setting) much higher than current systems (less than 20 m).

articleTitle: Design of Intelligent Analog Circuit Generation System
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: The design of analog circuits is a time-consuming and complex task that usually requires the development and simulation of a suitable language to describe the circuit. Therefore, this paper proposes an intelligent generation system for analog circuits based on the fundamental theory of circuits using a combination of Python and LTspice. The system is characterized by the generation of a “.asc” text description file by Python, which is then opened by LTspice to obtain an automatically generated analog circuit. The LTspice model of the electronic components of the circuit is a textual description, and with the textual description of each electronic component, the textual file can be processed using the capabilities of the Python programming language. This approach allows users to automatically generate multiple standard circuit diagram files from Python scripts, facilitating batch circuit design and testing without the need to manually draw circuit diagrams, simplifying the process of circuit design and testing, and improving efficiency, which plays an important role in automated circuit design and verification.

articleTitle: A Method for Constructing Enterprise Business Portrait Based on Label Layered and Extended Modeling
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: The goal of this academic research is to improve the accuracy and timeliness of the description of corporate operating conditions. By integrating in-depth modeling technology of label stratification, as well as cutting-edge data mining and machine learning algorithms, the business characteristics of enterprises are analyzed from multiple angles and in depth, and their dynamic update process is realized. In the deep learning architecture, the EPLLD model is constructed by integrating bidirectional long short-term memory network (BiLSTM) and feature extraction technology. The model has demonstrated excellent performance in processing large corporate text data sets. The research results show that the EPLLD model significantly surpasses the performance of existing models in key performance evaluation criteria such as precision, recall rate and F1 score. Experiments have shown that this strategy can significantly enhance the resolution of corporate portraits and the accuracy of predictions, thereby providing solid data support for enterprises and helping corporate managers make more targeted decisions.

articleTitle: An Anomalous Power Usage Detection Method Based on Multi-Dimensional Load Feature
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: With the development of smart grid technology, abnormal power usage detection has become an important task to ensure the stability of power supply. This paper proposes an abnormal power usage detection method that combines power user behaviour with multidimensional load feature mining. The method firstly divides the power consumption data of power users into load sub-sequences to construct more representative feature inputs. Then, a convolutional neural network (CNN) combined with a channel attention mechanism (CBAM) is used to effectively extract the temporally coupled features to improve the model's ability to focus on important information. In addition, dimensionality reduction of power user behaviour features is performed by a feature selection framework to reduce redundant information and improve the operational efficiency and detection accuracy of the model. Experiments have shown that this method significantly improves the detection ability of abnormal power user behaviour in real power monitoring, providing an innovative solution for the power industry with good application prospects.

articleTitle: A CC-CFBP Imaging Method for MIMO Radar
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: MIMO radar often generates significant sidelobes during back-projection (BP) imaging, which can interfere with target localization. To address this issue, this paper proposes a back-projection imaging algorithm based on the combination of cross-correlation and coherence factor. Firstly, calculate the coherence factor (CF) using radar echo data from each channel. In order to utilize the coherence of the target signal in the echo, cross-correlation operation is added in the process of BP imaging. Finally, the radar image is weighted with the corresponding coherence factor to suppress the sidelobes. The experimental results show that the method proposed in this paper reduces the integral side lobe ratio (ISLR) by 16.66 dB compared to traditional BP imaging results, and can effectively suppress the sidelobes in radar images.

articleTitle: A Spatio-Temporal Transformer Model-Based Method for Recognising Abnormal Human Behaviour in Complex Scenes
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: Real-time detection and reliable identification of abnormal human behavior is an important guarantee to improve the level of security monitoring and disposal of unsafe events in scenic spots. Aiming at the complex structure of the scenic environment and the difficulty of matching accurately between the frames of image sequences in traditional methods, the research proposes a spatio-temporal Transformer-based method for identifying abnormal human behaviors in scenic areas, which consists of two parts, namely, human gesture estimation and action analysis. The human posture estimation module uses the feature enhancement method to obtain the multi-scale information of the features, which can improve the accuracy of joint coordinate positioning of the human posture; the action analysis module constructs the spatio-temporal Transformer action analysis model to model the spatial dependence of different skeletal joint nodes and the temporal relationship of the same node in different image frames, which can effectively alleviate the confusion problem of the prediction of the action caused by the poor matching of the skeletal joints. The problem of motion prediction due to poor matching of skeletal joints can be effectively mitigated. The experimental results show that the method effectively enhances the feature representation of abnormal behaviors by making full use of spatio-temporal information, and the accuracy of abnormal behavior recognition is improved by 4.18%.

articleTitle: N-SSOR: A Low-Complexity Approach for Signal Detection in Massive MIMO Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: In massive multiple-input-multiple-output (MIMO) systems, the minimum mean square error (MMSE) and zero forcing (ZF) methods provide near-optimal performance. However, these techniques involve matrix inversion, which is computationally demanding and increases complexity. In this paper, we propose a signal detection algorithm with reduced complexity based on the symmetric successive overrelaxation (SSOR) and Neumann series called N-SSOR, which can reduce the complexity and get better results. We use Neumann series method in approximation, then, we use the result as the initial value of SSOR method to iterate. The results of our analysis indicate that the proposed N-SSOR algorithm significantly lowers computational complexity, decreasing it from <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\boldsymbol{\mathcal{O}(\mathrm{K}^{3})}$</tex> to <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\boldsymbol{\mathcal{O}(\mathrm{K}^{2})}$</tex>. In the case of a <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$128\times 8$</tex> massive MIMO system, with a signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) set at 15 dB, the bit error rate (BER) observed for the MMSE algorithm is <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$3.47\times 10^{-4}$</tex>. In comparison, the N-SSOR algorithm yields a BER of 3. <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$63\times 10^{-4}$</tex>. Furthermore, the BERs for the SSOR and Gauss-Seidel (GS) algorithms are considerably higher at <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$2.27\times 10^{-3}$</tex> and 0.06, respectively. These findings illustrate that the N-SSOR algorithm achieves performance that is nearly on par with the traditional MMSE method while requiring fewer iterations, highlighting its efficiency and effectiveness in practical applications.

articleTitle: The Research on Multi-Class Sea Clutter Data Simulation Method Based on AC-GAN
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: Clutter interference significantly affects the detection performance of radar systems. Therefore, simulating clutter during the radar development process is of paramount importance. In recent years, generative deep learning has advanced rapidly, with techniques such as Variational Autoencoders (VAE) and Generative Adversarial Networks (GAN) being widely applied in the field of image sample augmentation. In the area of clutter data simulation, artificial intelligence has also achieved notable success. This paper proposes a sea clutter data simulation method based on AC-GAN, which successfully simulates sea clutter data.

articleTitle: Design of A Charge Pump Phase Locked Loop in DC-DC Chip
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: In this paper, Cadence simulation software is used to design a phase-locked loop for charge pump integrated into the power management chip based on the 0.18um BCD process. Among them, the Frequency Discrimination Phase Detector (PFD) increases the delay time of the reset delay circuit on the basis of the traditional D-flip-flop structure, and reduces the “dead zone” of phase identification. The charge pump adopts a source switch structure with symmetrical charge and discharge current, which solves the influence of current loss distribution and charge injection. In addition, a programmable crossover circuit consisting of a D-flip-flop is designed. The simulation results show that the phase-locked loop of the charge pump can be synchronized with the external clock in the frequency range of 0.6~4.5 MHz at a supply voltage of 3.4V and a temperature range of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$-40^{\circ}\mathrm{C}\sim 125^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$</tex>, with a locking time of less than 40µm and a power consumption of less than 1.2 mW.

articleTitle: Study on Anti-Jamming Identification of Laser Near-Bomb Fuzed Features Based on Echo Feature Operator
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: In this study, an anti-jamming identification method based on echo feature operator is proposed for the plant interference problem faced by ultra-low altitude laser fuzes in the field environment. The article firstly analyses the transmission characteristics of LIDAR at close range and extracts one-dimensional time-domain features to analyse the difference between the echo signals of the plant (interference source) and the target (metal). Then, an anti-jamming recognition algorithm based on the echo feature operator is proposed, which distinguishes the two by quantifying the discrepancy between the metallic target echo signature and the non-metallic target. By using the Euclidean distance between vectors to compare the echo feature operators of the target to be recognised with the metal echo feature operators in the database, the anti-jamming recognition of typical metal targets is achieved. The experimental results show that the algorithm can improve the target metal recognition rate and accuracy by about 10%, and the misjudgement rate can be reduced by about 5%, with an overall accuracy of 93.50%.

articleTitle: Optimisation of the Performance of Push-Pull Disc Type Fibre Optic Accelerometer
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: Push-pull fiber-optic disk acceleration sensors have a wide range of applications in the field of vibration monitoring due to their high response accuracy to acceleration signals and anti-interference ability. In this paper, the potential of push-pull structure in optimizing the resonance frequency and sensitivity of the disk-type fibre-optic accelerometer is analyzed from the perspective of material and geometry properties, and its performance in the 5 kHz band is analyzed by combining with the COMSOL finite element simulation. The results show that the resonant frequency and sensitivity of the sensor can be significantly optimized by rationally configuring the thickness and radius of the push-pull structure as well as the Young's modulus and density of the material. The research in this paper provides theoretical guidance and practical reference for design of the high-performance push-pull fibre-optic acceleration sensors.

articleTitle: A Sentiment Classification Method Focused on Emotional Regions and Image-text Interaction Fusion
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: Image-text information has become mainstream on current social platforms, with image-text sentiment analysis leveraging the complementarity between different modalities to improve sentiment classification performance. In current tasks for image-text sentiment analysis, images often contain significant emotion-irrelevant noise, so focusing on emotional regions within images can greatly impact sentiment classification. Facial expressions, in particular, play a critical role in determining sentiment polarity. This paper proposes an image-text sentiment analysis model that emphasizes facial regions and image-text interactive fusion. In this model, BERT and ResNet are used to extract text and image features, while a convolutional model fine-tuned for facial emotion recognition captures facial expression features. By incorporating a global attention mechanism and a multi-modal fusion module, the model selectively filters and integrates emotional signals from cross-modal information, enabling effective classification of image-text sentiment tendencies. Experimental results on the MVSA datasets show an average improvement in accuracy and F1-score by 1.18% and 1.59%, respectively, compared to the best-performing baseline model.

articleTitle: Research on Cloud Security Protection Based on Microisolation Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: Cloud computing technology is becoming more and more popular in enterprises, but it also breaks the traditional partition mode of enterprises. Starting from the importance of microisolation technology in cloud resource protection, this paper analyzes the key technologies and implementation principles of microisolation application in cloud security protection scenarios, and studies and designs the architecture of microisolation technology. Use the support vector machine algorithm to analyze the security status between microisolation areas, thus forming a microisolation strategy model. Through the analysis of the actual case of power enterprises using microisolation technology, it shows that microisolation technology significantly improves and protects cloud security network security. Compare the application prospects of microisolation technology in private cloud, public cloud and hybrid cloud respectively.

articleTitle: Multiple Objective Scheduling Optimization Algorithm Based on Grey Wolf Optimization and Variable Neighborhood Search Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: Multi-objective scheduling is a key problem in the field of scheduling optimization such as warehouse logistics. Aiming at the problems of insufficient local search ability and difficult multi-objective trade-off in the existing methods, this article proposes an improved GWO-VNS algorithm. According to existing research, significant enhancements in local search capability and multi-objective optimization performance are achieved by incorporating the variable neighborhood search algorithm and applying crossover and mutation operations. The comparative experimental results show that the IGD index of GWO-VNS algorithm is reduced by 33%, and the HV index is increased by 11%, which verifies its significant advantages in multi-objective scheduling problems.

articleTitle: Chipless RFID Temperature and Humidity Sensing Tag Design for Environmental Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: Chipless RFID temperature and humidity sensing tags are important for monitoring complex environments. In this paper, a 16-bit encoded chipless RFID temperature and humidity sensing tag is designed. Designed to expand the encoding capacity by adding additional resonant units to the base spiral structure, changing the size of a single resonant structure to accomplish 16-bit encoding. The sensing function is accomplished by covering the resonant structure with smart materials. Ethylene tetrafluoroethylene for temperature sensing and polyvinyl alcohol for humidity sensing. The overall size of the label is (54. 6×31. 6×0. 787) mm3,The chipless temperature and humidity sensing tags designed in this paper have the advantages of miniaturization, compactness and low cost, and can be used for a variety of target identification and temperature and humidity monitoring of the environment.

articleTitle: A Shallow Water Modal Wave Separation Method Based on Modified Warping Transformation
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: In response to the issues of mode aliasing and reduced separation clarity of modal waves under non-ideal waveguide conditions in actual marine environments with variable sound speed profiles, we propose a modified Warping transformation modal separation method based on the BDRM wave number displacement ray modal wave model. This method involves refining the Warping transformation based on the BDRM acoustic field model, reconstructing the Warping operator for dual-phase compensation of the received signals. The transformed received signals are then projected in the time-frequency domain to achieve clear separation of all modal orders. Simulation experiments demonstrate that this method effectively separates higher-order modal waves for broadband pulse signals under both simulated negative sound speed gradient waveguides and measured shallow water waveguide conditions in the Qingdao sea area, showing broader applicability compared to traditional Warping transformations.

articleTitle: Application of CAPSO-Optimized VMD Algorithm in Non-Contact Extraction of Breathing and Heartbeat Signals from Millimeter-Wave Radar
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: With the continuous development of biomedical technology, non-contact life signal monitoring techniques have gradually gained attention. This paper proposes a Variational Mode Decomposition (VMD) method optimized by a Chaotic Adaptive Particle Swarm Optimization (CAPSO) algorithm for extracting breathing and heartbeat signals from millimeter-wave radar signals. The method integrates Adaptive Threshold Wavelet Transform (ATWT) for denoising, thereby enhancing the quality and accuracy of the signals. Experimental results show that the CAPSO-VMD algorithm significantly outperforms traditional Empirical Mode Decomposition (EMD), Ensemble Empirical Mode Decomposition (EEMD) and Improved Complete Ensemble Empirical Mode Decomposition with Adaptive Noise (ICEEMDAN) in terms of signal extraction accuracy and noise suppression capability.In the experiments, vital sign monitoring was conducted on 15 subjects using the AWR1642 millimeter-wave radar system. The results indicate that the average relative errors of the breathing rate and heart rate extracted by the CAPSO-VMD algorithm were 1.4% and 1.1%, respectively, validating its effectiveness and feasibility. This research provides new methods and ideas for non-contact life signal monitoring technology, demonstrating broad application prospects, especially in telemedicine and health monitoring fields.

articleTitle: Design of Bus Protocol Conversion Board Based on FPGA+ARM for Large Scientific Installations
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: In large scientific installations, there are various intelligent monitoring and control terminals, each using a different bus communication protocol. This project involves the system development of an embedded universal middleware based on ARM and FPGA. The system mainly includes a core bus module, a USB communication module and a signal relay module. It is connected to the host computer through USB and communicates with various smart devices at the other end. The system allows the host to freely select the desired bus communication protocol, thus realizing the communication with various intelligent devices. Simulations and tests show that the system can accurately and losslessly transmit various data and meet the requirements of large scientific installations.

articleTitle: Analysis of Microstrip Patch Antenna Array Beamforming Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: By constructing deep neural network models, the beamforming and pointing control of microwave antenna arrays can be optimized. The model can learn the optimal excitation values under different input conditions and achieve intelligent beam adjustment. Compared with traditional methods, the deep learning-based method has obvious advantages in performance. Specifically, it has higher spectral efficiency, stronger robustness, and faster convergence speed. Traditional methods usually rely on complex mathematical modeling and large computing resources, while the deep learning-based method utilizes its powerful data processing ability and adaptive learning ability to significantly improve design efficiency and accuracy. Future research can further explore the application of deep learning in more complex antenna array systems.

articleTitle: A Computer Simulation of High Explosive Cloud Lifting in Instantaneous Force
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: The lifting of high explosive cloud playing a significant role in diffusion, distribution and settlement of particle following. As the expensive cost of high explosion test, numerical simulation existing a better method. In this paper, the scale, temperature and density changes of the high explosive cloud are analyzed based on two sets of numerical simulation experiments on the rising of the high explosive cloud in different conditions, which provides reference value for researching the source term of the high explosive flowing field.

articleTitle: Lane Line Detection Algorithm Based on Global Attention and Reconstruction of Spatial Pyramid Pooling
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: To address the key issues present in traditional lane line detection methods, such as high computational cost, neglect of visual cues, and insufficient handling of occluded lane lines, this paper optimizes and improves the UFLDV2 (Ultra Fast Deep Lane Detection with Hybrid Anchor Driven Ordinal Classification) network model. The backbone network is replaced with DenseNet-121 to enhance feature reuse, and atrous depthwise separable convolution (Atrous DSC) is employed for network lightweighting by expanding the receptive field and strengthening information aggregation. Additionally, a lightweight global attention mechanism (GAM) that incorporates depthwise separable convolution (DSC) is introduced into the feature extraction network, improving the ability to recognize lane lines. The spatial pyramid pooling structure (SPPCSPC) is reconstructed to retain more detailed lane line feature information. The L-Boundary (Lane Boundary loss) function is used to focus more on lane line edge information. These mechanisms help mitigate the issues of information loss during convolution and pooling in the UFLDV2 algorithm. Experimental results show that the detection accuracy on the TuSimple dataset reaches 97.34<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>, while the F1 score on the CUlane dataset is 76.7%, indicating an improvement in recognition rates and demonstrating competitive performance.

articleTitle: Research on Digital Engraving Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: The hand-carving plate-making technique is widely used in special printing, such as banknotes. However, its high technical requirements and time-consuming engraving process significantly limit the promotion and application of this technique, which possesses unique artistic expression effects. This study utilizes computer image processing algorithms to handle continuous tone images, simulating the effects of hand-carving to enhance plate-making speed and efficiency, thus providing significant research value. In this paper, we propose a digital carving algorithm based on the grayscale information of continuous tone images, combined with image segmentation algorithms and the modulation of carrier curve line widths, to construct an end-to-end digital carving image generation model. This model first employs a semantic segmentation algorithm to divide the image into segments, designing and generating carrier graphic grid lines based on the features of each segmented area. Subsequently, it modulates the feature parameters of the lines point by point according to the grayscale information of the original image, applying transformations such as rotation, distortion, and thickening. Finally, details such as cross-carving are added for enhanced rendering. The results indicate that the engraving effect of the output images achieved by this method closely resembles that of traditional digital carving, demonstrating its practical application value.

articleTitle: Localized Binarization of Document Images Based on Suprathreshold Stochastic Resonance
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: When processing text images with traditional binarization methods, the image background noise often causes the results to become blurred or leads to the loss of edge details. To solve this problem, this paper proposes an image binarization method based on stochastic resonance theory. First, we divide the image into sub-blocks and set a binarization threshold based on the statistical properties of the pixels in each sub-block. Next, the image signal is converted into a one-dimensional time series signal using Hilbert scanning. The processed signals are input into a threshold array system, which amplifies the weak edge information in the input signals through the stochastic resonance phenomenon. Subsequently, we performed modulation and inverse scanning on the output signals of the system to generate the binary image for each sub-block. Finally, all sub-block binary images were combined to complete the binarization of the overall image. Experimental results show that the method proposed in this paper can effectively retain the detailed information of document images and significantly outperforms the traditional binarization method regarding image quality.

articleTitle: Speech Emotion Recognition Based on Graph Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: Speech emotion recognition (SER) is a crucial aspect of human-computer interaction that has garnered significant attention. To address the challenges of low efficiency and poor recognition accuracy in current SER systems, this paper proposes a speech emotion classification model based on a graph convolutional neural network (GCN). To further enhance the GCN's ability to extract speech emotion features, the model incorporates a self-attention mechanism. This mechanism enables the model to dynamically adjust the influence between different nodes, allowing it to better handle complex graph structures and extract more salient speech features. Additionally, to further improve the model's classification accuracy, the XGBoost algorithm is employed for speech emotion classification. Compared to traditional GCN-based SER models, the proposed method achieves a 3% improvement in classification accuracy.

articleTitle: Research on Network Topology Visualization System
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: Network topology visualization system shows the nodes and connections in the network graphically, which makes the complex network structure easy to understand and analyze. The design of such a system needs to consider the user's operating habits, the efficiency of data processing and the accuracy of the algorithm. The user interface layer provides an intuitive operating platform where users can add or move network nodes with simple clicks and drags to update the network layout in real time. The service layer handles more complex logic, such as dynamic changes of connections between nodes and real-time monitoring of network traffic, to ensure the accuracy and real-time performance of network topology. The data layer is responsible for storing the basic information of the network, including node attributes, connection relationships and network configuration parameters, providing data support for the business layer. As a key technology in network topology visualization, force-directed layout algorithm adjusts the position of nodes by simulating the forces in the physical world, making the network diagram both beautiful and practical. This algorithm can quickly respond to changes in the network structure and maintain the rationality and aesthetics of the layout even when the number of nodes increases dramatically. The optimized force-directed placement algorithm not only improves the computational efficiency, but also enhances the adaptability of the algorithm, so that it can deal with network topologies of various sizes, from small local area networks to the global coverage of the Internet, and can provide effective placement schemes. The optimization of the algorithm makes the network topology visualization system more flexible and powerful in practical applications, and provides a powerful tool for network management and optimization.

articleTitle: Towards Computing Power Networks: A Case of Enhancing Eavesdropping-Mitigation Mechanisms with Programmable Data Planes
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: The Programmable Data Plane (PDP) is a paradigm of providing in-network computing for Computing Power Networks (CPN). With PDP, multiple computing services (e.g., DNS) can be offloaded on edge-network-devices. These in-network services have advantages of decreasing their response delay and increasing the utilization of computing power for edge-network-devices. However, it is a vacant area for CPN to enhance eavesdropping-mitigation mechanisms using the PDP. In this paper, we propose a novel CPN-powered eavesdropping-mitigation mechanism with the PDP. In particular, the mechanism provides an in-network privacy-level classification for traffic packets. The classification first extracts payloads from packets, then analyzes the payloads using an AI algorithm on the PDP, finally forwards the packets according to the analysis results. Experimental results show that the proposed mechanism can classify and forward packets effectively.

articleTitle: Health Evaluation of the Operating State of the Metrological Secondary Loop based on Comprehensive Valuation Method
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: In order to solve the problem that the secondary loop cycle inspection of the gateway metering device is not targeted, each state quantity affecting the secondary loop of the gateway power metering device is analyzed, quantified and normalized. Based on the full-time verification, the comprehensive assignment method combining entropy weight method and order relation analysis method is used to determine the weight coefficient of each state quantity. After the overall score of state evaluation is obtained, the health degree of the secondary loop is determined, and the fault diagnosis and maintenance strategy are adjusted. This paper introduces the concept of full-time check, emphatically analyzes the principle of subjective and objective assignment method and its application in secondary loop state evaluation. The health evaluation system based on full-time verification uses real-time monitoring data, field verification data, secondary loop configuration and other information to evaluate the health of the secondary loop. The results of health evaluation provide a reliable basis for fault diagnosis of metering secondary circuits. The result of the example verifies the correctness of the comprehensive assignment method based on the full-time check.

articleTitle: Design of Low Power Low Temperature Drift Reference Current Source with Startup Circuit
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: This article addresses the issues of complex and high power consumption in low-temperature drift reference current source circuits, and designs a reference current source with low power consumption, low-temperature drift, and a wide power supply voltage range. The reference current source adopts the temperature characteristics of the <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathbf{V}_{\mathbf{B}\mathbf{E}}$</tex> and <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\triangle\mathbf{V}_{\mathbf{B}\mathbf{E}}$</tex> of the transistor, exhibiting a near zero temperature characteristic. In order to eliminate the two non ideal operating degeneracy points in the circuit, a starting circuit is designed to ensure that the reference current source starts up to normal working state after the power is turned on, while improving the stability of the circuit. The circuit is designed based on 0.18um BCD technology and applied in a soft start circuit of a step-down DC-DC converter. The results show that the circuit proposed in this article outputs a reference current of 2.92uA, a temperature drift coefficient of 182.2ppm/°C, and an overall current consumption of 7.5uA at an input voltage of 2.1-5.5V power supply voltage and a temperature range of -25~125 °C.

articleTitle: Effect of Defects on the C-V Characteristics for AlGaN/GaN MIS-HEMTs Based on 2D Simulations
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: This study investigates the influence of defects on the capacitance-voltage (C-V) characteristics of AlGaN/GaN metal insulator semiconductor high electron mobility transistors (MIS-HEMTs) by using two-dimensional (2D) simulations. The results reveal that the acceptor defects primarily trap electrons, while the donor defects facilitate electron emission. Then, defects were introduced at different locations of the MIS-HEMT model for further investigation. Specifically, defects at the AlGaN/GaN interface and/or within the GaN channel layer significantly affect the electron density, leading to a significant shift in the C-V curves. In contrast, defects located within the AlGaN barrier layer have minimal influence on the C-V characteristics. Moreover, it is found that increased defect density can lead to more electrons being trapped or emitted, exacerbating the effect of defects on C-V characteristics. This study provides valuable theoretical insights into the effects of defects on the electrical properties of AlGaN/GaN MIS-HEMTs, facilitating the optimization of the device performance through defect passivation.

articleTitle: Coprime Coarray Interpolation-Based Space Time Adaptive Processing for Clutter Suppression
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: It is known that space-time adaptive processing for clutter suppression with coprime arrays can offer improved capability at a reduced cost compared to uniform linear arrays. However, existing spatial-temporal smoothing-based approaches only utilize consecutive degrees of freedom (DoFs) due to the holes in the coprime difference coarray. This paper proposes a new approach to overcome the limitation of spatial-temporal smoothing-based approaches. More precisely, the problem of estimating the virtual augmented clutter covariance matrix is first formulated as an atomic norm minimization problem via virtual difference coarray interpolation. Then, the traditional principle components method can be applied directly. Compared with existing spatial-temporal smoothed-based STAP algorithms, this approach can fully exploit complete all available DoFs and achieve better performance of clutter suppression. Numerical simulations are provided to illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: A Memristor-Based Winograd Fast Fourier Transform Computation Circuit
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) is an important technology in signal processing and digital analysis. As an optimized FFT algorithm, the Winograd FFT algorithm can reduce the number of multipliers, but the multiplication calculation in the circuit implementation is still the power consumption and speed bottleneck of the traditional processor. Memristor is an effective method to solve this problem because of its low power consumption and unique advantages in multiply accumulation operation. Therefore, in this paper, a Winogard FFT operation circuit based on memristors is proposed. The proposed circuit can support 8 different point of FFT operation, up to 16-point. The circuit can also be used as the basic unit circuit to realize FFT operation with larger points. Compared with the implementation of DFT with a memristor crossbar array, it avoids the weight mapping of a complex transformation matrix and only needs to map the two weights of 0 and 1. The simulation results show that the proposed circuit has good performance under different FFT operations. In addition, we also analyze the influence of the fluctuation of the memristor resistance on the 16-point FFT operation performance, and the SPICE simulation verifies that the signal-to-noise ratio can be greater than 20 dB when the resistance fluctuation is less than 10%.

articleTitle: Optical Power Prediction Model for Integrated Learning Based on Dendrite Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: Optical power is one of the indexes to measure the running state of optical fiber communication network. It is a kind of time series data with the characteristics of complexity, time variability and nonlinearity. To solve the problem of poor prediction accuracy of existing models, a Stacking integrated learning optical power prediction model based on dendrite networks is proposed. Firstly, Classification and Regression Tree (CART), Long Short-Term Memory network (Long short-term Memory, Three kinds of models, LSTM and Support Vector Regression (SVR), are used as learning tools. Dendrite network algorithm is introduced to establish the state prediction model of power optical communication system based on Stacking learning. Secondly, in order to verify the performance of the proposed model, it is compared with three base learners and the prediction models based on dendrite network Bagging ensemble learning and Boosting ensemble learning. The experimental results show that the MSE value of the proposed model is 0.0105, which decreases by 58.1183%, 6.3055% and 93.9329% compared with the three base learners, and decreases by 90.3618% and 42.1601% compared with Bagging-DD and Boosting-DD, respectively. The prediction accuracy and stability of the proposed model on the optical power data set are the highest, and compared with the single prediction model, the model can realize the state prediction of the power optical communication system.

articleTitle: Study on the Wind-Induced Vibration Response of OPGW Cables under Icing Conditions
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: Optical ground wire (OPGW) cables, which incorporate optical fibers for high-speed data transmission, exhibit vibration responses under wind that are influenced by icing conditions. This paper investigates the wind-induced vibration response of OPGW under icing conditions through finite element simulations. Initially, a model was developed based on specific OPGW cable parameters, and wind load data under varying ice thicknesses were generated using the Davenport spectrum. The simulation results indicate that as ice thickness increases, the wind resistance of OPGW cables is significantly enhanced, resulting in reductions in the amplitude and frequency of both displacement and velocity vibrations. Additionally, φ-OTDR technology was employed in experimental tests on OPGW cables of the same type to observe wind-induced vibrations, and the experimental results aligned closely with the simulations, confirming the validity of the simulation model.

articleTitle: Remaining Useful Life Prediction for Aero-Engine Based on Gaussian-LSTM
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: Data-driven Remaining Useful Life (RUL) prediction methods for aero-engines have been widely adopted in recent years. However, existing deep learning-based methods typically provide only point predictions and are limited in quantifying predictive uncertainty. To address this, this paper proposes a Gaussian-LSTM (G-LSTM)-based RUL prediction method for aero-engines. G-LSTM effectively captures time-series information throughout the degradation process and employs a customized Gaussian layer to estimate the RUL mean and standard deviation, generating a Gaussian distribution of the RUL. This approach overcomes traditional methods' limitations in quantifying predictive uncertainty. Experimental results on the CMAPSS dataset demonstrate that G-LSTM achieves the highest accuracy in Probability Density Function (PDF) curve prediction over the entire lifecycle, enhancing its practical applicability.

articleTitle: Embedded FPGA Design and Tool Chain Integration Under 40nm TSMC Process
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: eFPGA is an IP core that embeds an FPGA-like programmable logic array into an SoC, providing it with configurable flexibility, excellent performance, and power efficiency. This article details the design of an eFPGA soft core IP featuring 2K LUT4 resources with three configuration interfaces, including its global architecture, configurable logic modules, configurable l/O modules, and the structure of the configuration circuit. Furthermore, the article introduces an EDA tool chain integrated with this eFPGA core, enabling users to convert RTL code into a configuration bitstream throughout the entire process. Finally, the paper conducts functional tests on the chip containing the eFPGA designed in this article.

articleTitle: Fabric Defect Detection Algorithm Based on Improved YOLOv8
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: Fabric quality is negatively affected by various defects during the production process. Detecting fabric defects is therefore an essential measure in improving industrial fabric production and reducing production losses. This paper presents an AES-YOLOv8 network architecture based on YOLOv8 for detecting fabrics that are difficult to detect due to complex texture backgrounds and limited hardware resources. In order to construct a Slim-neck architecture, the Conv in the YOLOv8 neck network is replaced with GSConv and the C2f module with VoV-GSCSP. This architecture can effectively extract and represent subtle features, better capture fabric defect details, and reduce computational complexity while maintaining high accuracy. Further, an EMA-efficient multi-scale attention mechanism has been integrated into the neck to enhance the ability of the model to detect defects in complex settings. Finally, ASFF was utilized for feature output, and an ASFF-head detection head was constructed to adaptively learn the spatial weights of feature maps at different scales during fusion, so that the key features of defect targets can be captured at a variety of scales with greater precision and accuracy. Comparatively to the baseline model YOLOv8n, AES-YOLOv8 demonstrated an accuracy improvement of 2.1%, a recall improvement of 0.3%, a mAP50 improvement of 1.6%, and a mAP50:90 improvement of 2.5%. This confirms the advantages of AES-YOLOv8 in the detection of fabric defects. In addition to locating these defects efficiently and minimizing waste, it also has a great deal of practical value.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Mask2Former for Segmenting Small Mushroom Caps of Seafood Mushrooms
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: In the task of monitoring mushroom growth characteristics, the mushroom cap is one of the most important features. To address the challenges faced by traditional instance segmentation algorithms in segmenting the caps of seafood mushrooms during the early stages of growth, such as unclear edges and low success rates. This paper proposes the application of the Mask2Former algorithm for instance segmentation of the caps of seafood mushrooms in their early differentiation stage. First, camera equipment was set up to capture images of the mushroom house for dataset creation. Then, the collected images were augmented through techniques such as flipping and adding noise. Finally, the processed images were input into the model, allowing Mask2Former to be compared with three other instance segmentation algorithms. Experimental results demonstrated that Mask2Former performed better in segmenting small mushroom caps during the early growth stage of seafood mushrooms, achieving an average precision (AP) of 96.731%, which effectively meets practical production needs.

articleTitle: Design of an Aircraft Attitude Control System Based on Fuzzy Logic
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: With the widespread use of aircraft in civil and military applications, the demand for efficient attitude control systems is increasing. This paper proposes a design method for an aircraft attitude control system based on fuzzy logic. The system uses fuzzy logic to deal with the nonlinear and uncertain problems that are common in the aircraft attitude control process. We designed and simulated two fuzzy controllers, Mamdani and Sugeno, and compared them with traditional PID controllers. The results show that the fuzzy controller is superior to the traditional PID control system in terms of response speed, stability and adaptability to changes in flight conditions, especially when dealing with disturbances and nonlinear dynamic changes, showing stronger adaptability and robustness.

articleTitle: Coherent Processing Method for Frequency-Agile Radar Based on Velocity Phase Linearization
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: Frequency-agile radar possesses superior antijamming capabilities; however, frequency agility introduces coupling issues among target range, velocity, and frequency-hopping coefficients, complicating efficient coherent processing. This paper proposes a joint carrier and pulse repetition frequency agile waveform design method that decouples the phase relationship between target velocity and carrier frequency agility. For this jointly agile waveform, a signal processing scheme combining range dimension phase compensation, velocity-domain FFT, and waveform entropy detection is proposed, reducing the processing complexity of two-dimensional search imaging for frequency-agile radar. Simulation results validate the method's effectiveness, providing a feasible design solution for frequency-agile radar.

Author Keywords: Pulse Repetition Frequency Agility (PRF Agility) Depth First Search

articleTitle: Research on E-Commerce Intelligent Recommendation System Based on Big Data Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: With the gradual improvement of China's e-commerce environment, including the continuous maturity of network infrastructure, legal environment, market environment, online payment, information security and certification centre construction, the e-commerce industry has ushered in unprecedented development opportunities. This paper focuses on the application of big data analytics in e-commerce intelligent recommendation system, and aims to reveal how big data analytics can help e-commerce achieve accurate marketing and optimize the marketing process through in-depth discussion of its data collection, web page construction, core concepts and mathematical model formulas. The empirical results show that the system in this paper has a better predictive effect than the traditional model.

articleTitle: Research on Cross Layer Congestion Delay Tolerance Control Algorithm for Multi Priority Communication Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: The phenomenon of transmission link congestion is a direct factor affecting the transmission efficiency of communication networks. Due to the large amount of data and complex topology in communication networks, it poses significant challenges to congestion control work. Therefore, this paper studies a cross layer congestion delay high tolerance control algorithm for multi priority communication networks. Set AODV cross layer protocol as the constraint condition for link congestion control, and obtain the detection and prediction results of transmission link congestion status through the calculation of duty cycle and threshold comparison. For transmission links with congestion and congestion risks, consider calculating congestion control quantity based on link capacity, calculating congestion control priority, and completing congestion control tasks. The conclusion drawn from performance testing experiments is that the proposed method reduces the degree of transmission link queue and the proportion of congested links, significantly improves network data transmission speed, reduces packet loss rate, and improves normalized network throughput. Therefore, the design method has significant advantages in control performance and application performance.

articleTitle: Research on Voiceprint Recognition Based on Improved Densenet
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: In the study of voiceprint recognition, the model parameters are large, the robustness is poor, and the features of voiceprint are not fully utilized. In this paper, an improved method based on Densenet framework for voice print recognition is proposed. Using DenseNet as backbone network, SE attention module is used to improve Dense Block in DenseNet network. The experimental results show that the improved Densenet (ERR: 0.87<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>) is superior to the traditional voice print recognition network.

articleTitle: Investigation of the Uniformity of Explosive Shock Wave Fronts in Variable Cross-Section Shock Tubes
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: A shock tube can simulate the explosive shock environment and is often used in research on biological injury mechanisms and the development and testing of protective technologies. A shock tube is usually composed of a driving section, a driven section, and a test section, and can generate shock waves by breaking a membrane with high-pressure gases (nitrogen, helium, or compressed air) or hydrogen-oxygen detonation. Studies have shown that shock waves will rapidly expand at the exit of the driven section of the shock tube, which can easily cause unevenness in the shock wave front at this location, affecting the test and research. Therefore, this study uses pressure sensors to study the non-uniformity at the exit of the shock tube. The experimental results show that when the free-field pressure peak value is 80 kPa, the shock wave is relatively uniform within 6 cm of the exit of the shock tube; when the free-field sensor is fixed at a certain distance, the non-uniformity of the simulated explosive shock wave generated by the shock tube increases as the free-field pressure peak value increases. This study reveals the non-uniform characteristics of the shock wave at the exit of the shock tube, which has important implications for improving the accuracy and reliability of shock tube experiments.

articleTitle: A Radar Emitter Threat Assessment Method with Incomplete Data
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: Radar emitter threat assessment plays a pivotal role in electronic warfare. However, conventional threat assessment methods perform poorly under conditions of data incompleteness. To address this issue, this paper proposes a new radar emitter threat assessment method. This method takes into account the inconsistency of the weight vectors among experts, proposing an AHP-improved structural entropy algorithm to calculate the weights of threat attributes. By introducing integrity and adaptive weight normalization, the method simultaneously considers integrity and threat degree, enabling comprehensive assessments under different data incomplete conditions. Experimental results verify that the proposed method achieves satisfactory assessment under the condition of substantial data incompleteness.

articleTitle: PixelDenoise: Purifying Adversarial Images in a Black-Box Way
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: Despite the outstanding compression quality of learned image compression (LIC), its vulnerability to adversarial attacks cannot be ignored. Our experiments show up to a 19.15 times increase in bits per pixel (bpp) under the PGD attack. Although the adversarial examples are unrecognizable to human eyes, we find PixelCNN++ effective at detecting and modifying them back to the original data distribution. Thus, we first propose PixelDenoise, which leverages PixelCNN++ to improve the performance of LIC models in a black-box way. This innovation significantly decreases the bpp change from 19.15 times to 2.56 times without worsening the reconstruction quality. Since PixelDenoise requires little detail about the attack or the model, it is more universal than white-box defense methods like adversarial training. Additionally, we simplified the sampling process of PixelDenoise by minimizing the context size, reducing the processing time from 9 hours to 5 minutes per full-resolution image, with memory consumption dropping from 24GB to 2GB.

articleTitle: A Infrared Imaging System for the Carbon-Based Shortwave Infrared Detector
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: High-sensitivity shortwave infrared (SWIR) detectors are crucial for infrared imaging. However, mainstream SWIR detectors require operation under low temperature conditions, incompatible with silicon-based readout circuits and exhibiting poor light absorption capabilities. We have developed a detector based on the p-i-n heterojunction of colloidal quantum dots (CQDs) and carbon nanotube (CNT) field-effect transistors, and designed a readout circuit system for testing and imaging, including a CNT FET-based shortwave infrared detector array, FPGA main control circuit, current acquisition and conversion circuit, row signal control circuit, and row gate circuit. The FPGA main control circuit is configured as the main control module and implemented using FPGA. It is used to select the shortwave infrared detector array, generate timing signals for controlling current acquisition and conversion circuit sampling, and receive the sampled and converted current digital signals, which are then sent to the upper computer for image processing and display. The shortwave infrared detector array readout circuit system of the present invention can achieve automated, high-precision, and high dynamic range photoelectric current signal readout, with a dynamic range of 66dB, a detectable current range of 0.4nA to 800nA, and high compatibility, compatible with detector arrays of 64*64 and below, and can perform arbitrary row and column windowing.

articleTitle: Solving Electromagnetic Inverse Scattering Problems with Low SNR Data Based on Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: In this paper, a denoising scheme based on convolutional neural network (CNN) is proposed for solving electromagnetic inverse scattering problems (EISPs) with low SNR data. We selected the U-Net and trained the network with the scattered field data disturbed by white Gaussian noise. The cross-correlated contrast source inversion (CC-CSI) method is used to reconstruct the target scatterers. Numerical inversion results concerning the transverse magnetic (TM) wave demonstrate that our proposed method can improve imaging quality and reconstruction precision in high-noise environments. In addition, our proposed method has excellent generalization ability for complicated 2-D models.

articleTitle: Context-Aware YOLOv7 Algorithm for Classroom Seating Distribution Recognition
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: Evaluating the effectiveness of classroom teaching is challenging, and one potential solution is the implementation of intelligent classrooms. A key difficulty in intelligent classrooms lies in accurately identifying student seating positions. To address this issue, this paper focuses on improving the YOLOv7 detection algorithm for classroom seat detection. The main contributions of this study are as follows: (1) To improve YOLOv7's detection efficiency in classroom environments, we propose an enhancement that incorporates local context and prior information to increase seat detection accuracy; (2) We introduce the concept of using local context based on classroom seating and YOLO's grid system to refine the algorithm's post-processing stage.
