Testing results show that the improved algorithm detects more seats in a classroom environment, with higher confidence in recognized seats. This approach enhances both recall rate and average recognition rate to a certain extent.

articleTitle: Research on High-Performance Microwave Antennas Based on Integrated Waveguides
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a novel high-performance microwave antenna design based on Substrate Integrated Waveguide (SIW). As an advanced guided wave structure, SIW has been widely used in the design of microwave antennas and other functional devices due to its high power capacity, easy integration with planar circuits, and low processing cost. However, there are still some problems that need to be solved urgently in the bandwidth expansion, multi-frequency response and circularly polarized radiation of SIW-based microwave antennas. In order to overcome these challenges, we designed a SIW-based wideband microwave antenna to solve the problem of narrow bandwidth due to the low profile of SIW. In this design, the SIW rectangular cavity is used as the resonator, and a drum-shaped slit is designed to excite high-order mixing modes (odd-TE120 and even-TE120), and a set of short-circuit vias are introduced into the antenna cavity to disturb the fundamental mode electric field, so as to realize the expansion of the antenna bandwidth. The designed antenna was comprehensively analyzed and simulated for optimization, and the actual experimental processing and testing were carried out. The experimental results are in good agreement with the simulation optimization results, which proves the effectiveness of the design. The antenna operates in the X-band with a relative operating bandwidth of 23.5%, a stable gain range of 5.6 dBi to 6.48 dBi, and a maximum cross-polarization level of less than -26 dB. This study provides a valuable reference for the future design of SIW-based high-performance microwave antennas.

articleTitle: Research on Key Technologies for Bird's Nest Detection in High-Speed Railway Catenary Systems Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: With the rapid development of high-speed railway technology, ensuring its operational safety has become a critical issue. In particular, real-time monitoring of the high-speed railway pantograph system is of utmost importance for preventing failures and reducing the incidence of accidents. The aim of this research is to enhance the intelligent detection performance of the high-speed railway pantograph network status, especially in the detection of bird nests, through an improved MobileNetV3 algorithm. The research methodology includes the application of deep learning and image processing technologies, focusing on optimizing the MobileNetV3 algorithm to increase its detection accuracy in complex environments, particularly its ability to identify bird nests in complex scenes and adapt to dynamic environments. It is expected that these improvements will enable more accurate and efficient monitoring of the status of high-speed railway pantographs, thereby enhancing the safe operation level of high-speed railways.

articleTitle: Wideband Dechirp Beamformer for Hyperbolic Frequency Modulation Waveforms
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: The dechirp beamformer (DEBF), designed for dechirp systems without relying on delay lines, offers significant advantages such as ease of engineering implementation and excellent wideband wide-angle scanning performance. Consequently, it has found widespread use in imaging radars based on linear frequency modulation (LFM) waveforms. However, when applied to hyperbolic frequency modulation (HFM) waveforms, this beamformer experiences a notable reduction in beam gain at large scanning angles due to phase and frequency setting errors, which limits the performance of the imaging system. To address this issue, this paper proposes a subarray-level HFM-DEBF based on higher-order Taylor expansion. By approximating the complex nonlinear nature of HFM signals as a sum of multiple linear polynomials using higher-order Taylor expansion, phase and frequency compensation values can be accurately set according to these approximate polynomials, ensuring high beam gain across all pointing directions. Finally, several simulation experiments were conducted, validating the superior performance of the proposed beamformer.

articleTitle: Service Network Design for Hybrid Fleets of Electric and Fuel-Powered Trucks
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: This work presents a column generation approach for solving the service network design Problem involving hybrid fleets of electric and fuel-powered trucks. The proposed model aims to minimize the total operational and transportation costs while accounting for product flows, vehicle capacities, and battery constraints in large-scale freight transportation networks. The hybrid fleet comprises electric trucks, which require periodic recharging, and fuel-powered trucks, both of which operate over a network of service, charging, and recirculating arcs. To manage the complexity of the problem, we decompose it into a master problem and two subproblems-one for each truck type-solved iteratively within a column generation framework. The master problem determines optimal product flows and truck assignments, while the subproblems generate cost-efficient service paths for electric and fuel-powered trucks. Dual variables from the master problem guide the subproblem optimization, ensuring that new columns, representing truck routes, are added to the master problem only if they improve the objective. Numerical results demonstrate the effectiveness of the approach in achieving cost-efficient fleet coordination in a hybrid network. The results show that the method can handle large-scale instances efficiently and significantly reduce operational costs for logistics companies adopting both electric and fuel-powered trucks.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Mini-App Shortcuts
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: With the enrichment of mobile application services, the Super-App mode is becoming more and more popular. As applications based on Super-Apps, Mini-Apps are faced with the problems that its internal functions are difficult to be discovered and its entry is too deep when used, so it is necessary to form Mini-App shortcuts. This paper has conducted in-depth research around the issue, and the main contributions are as follows: (1) We elaborate on the primary needs of Mini-App shortcuts; (2) We propose a basic model for Mini-App shortcuts; (3) We design an implementation method for Mini-App shortcuts. (4) We conducted experimental tests to measure the effects.

articleTitle: Named Entity Recognition for Electronic Medical Records Based on Multi-Feature Fusion and Global Context Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: In recent years, character-level BERT combined with BiLSTM-CRF models has achieved notable success in Chinese EMR named entity recognition (NER). However, relying solely on character sequences presents limitations, and BiLSTM struggles to effectively capture global context. To address these issues, we propose a Chinese EMR NER algorithm based on multifeature fusion and a global context mechanism. The method integrates character, pinyin, and radical features, and enhances BiLSTM's capacity for capturing global context through a global context mechanism, followed by CRF-based sequence decoding. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed approach outperforms existing baselines on the CCKS2017 and CCKS2018 datasets, significantly improving NER accuracy in Chinese EMRs, and highlighting its potential for practical application.

articleTitle: Study of Single Event Induced by Heavy Ions in 100V-Rated Enhancement-Mode pGaN/AlGaN/GaN HEMTs
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: According to our irradiation experiments and failure analysis, it was demonstrated that the E-mode pGaN/AlGaN/GaN HEMT devices exhibit sensitivity to heavy-ion irradiation, showing susceptibility to burnout or performance degradation depending on the biased voltages. The electric field distortion during the heavy ions irradiation induces a localized electric field spike, contributing to the connection between the gate and the drain. Furthermore, the accumulation effect also occurs, with the trapped holes under the gate identified as the primary cause of performance degradation.

articleTitle: Colonic Pressure Signal Analysis Method Based on Ensemble Support Vector Machine
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: Slow transit constipation is a common intestinal motility disorder. The colonic peristalsis can be well analyzed by the colonic pressure signal. However, medical physiological signal data are generally imbalanced, resulting in the low performance of traditional classification methods. To overcome this challenge, this paper proposes a Support Vector Machine classification method based on ensemble method. We extracted statistical features, nonlinear features and wavelet features from the colonic pressure signals, and integrated them as feature vectors to input the classifier. The experimental results show that, compared with the traditional support vector machine, the proposed method significantly improves the recognition effect of the minority class samples. Through grid search for model parameters optimization, ensemble support vector machine not only improves the recognition effect of minority class samples, but also maintains the recognition performance of majority class samples, which effectively alleviates the problem of biased toward the majority class in the classification process and improves the recognition accuracy of slow transit constipation patients.

articleTitle: Improvement Research Based on LEACH Protocol
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: Aiming at LEACH protocol in wireless sensor network energy consumption problems such as imbalance, random selection of cluster nodes, a LEACH-PM protocol was proposed, leveraging a fixed cluster swarm and multi-hop transmission. This approach incorporates both node energy and distance factors in the cluster head selection process. Additionally, three optimizations were introduced to enhance the traditional LEACH protocol: the network area is systematically divided into nine regions, each designated as a cluster group, with cluster nodes selected based on their fitness function values. Some clusters adopt the mode of multi-hop transmission. The MATLAB platform is used for simulation comparison, and compared with the original protocol, the improved protocol improves energy utilization and prolongs the network survival time.

articleTitle: Transformer Model for Early Futures Trading Classification with a Conditional Classifier Layer
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: Early classification of Time series models can help traders make decisions earlier, but the non-stationarity and high noise of futures trading data make traditional machine learning methods underperform. Although the current well-known Transformer models perform well in time series non-early classification applications, the fixed-length classification layer in Transformer models cannot effectively classify futures trading time series of different lengths early. Considering the above problems, this paper proposes the ECFormer model for early classification applications of time series such as futures trading. The ECFormer introduces an adaptive length conditional classifier layer into the existing model, and dynamically selecting the corresponding classifiers according to the length of the input data by constructing a set of classifiers with different input dimensions, the corresponding classifiers are dynamically selected for classification. The experimental results show that on the futures datasets of Egg, Corn and Soybean, the harmonic mean of the proposed method in this paper reaches 0.702, 0.661, 0.671, respectively, which is better than the existing classical methods CALIMERA and TEASER. In addition, the proposed method in this paper also performs well in early classification tasks on several other domain datasets in UCR.

articleTitle: An Edge Control Based Communication Network Architecture in New Power Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: With the rapid advancement of new power systems, the scale of various control and data services for substations is continuously expanding, which brings significant pressure on communication. Particularly, the existing electric communication network has a limited ability to integrate sensing, communication, control, and computation, which reduces resource utilization efficiency. Therefore, in this paper, we propose a communication network architecture designed for high-frequency data collection in the new power system. Firstly, we design an edge control based hierarchical communication architecture, considering various networking technologies, terminals and services. Additionally, to improve data collection efficiency, we discuss some key methods such as resource reuse and wired-wireless parallel transmission methods for the electrical privacy network.

articleTitle: Optimizing Multibeam Submarine Depth Sounding Through the Use of a Greedy Strategy Enhanced Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: In the context of rapid development in deep-sea exploration, this paper proposes an innovative optimization solution for measuring the depth of the seabed using a multibeam approach. The solution combines the greedy algorithm with the genetic algorithm to achieve efficient and precise path planning for seabed measurement. Firstly, a mathematical model is employed to describe the coverage characteristics of multibeam systems. Geometric analysis and trigonometric functions are utilized to accurately calculate coverage width and overlap ratio, ensuring complete coverage and efficient measurement. Then, the greedy algorithm is utilized to determine the initial layout of the survey lines, while the genetic algorithm is employed for further optimization. This dual approach helps to avoid getting stuck in local optimal solutions and enhances convergence speed. Finally, experimental results demonstrate that this approach effectively enhances measurement accuracy and coverage rate, providing an efficient optimization solution for underwater terrain measurement.

articleTitle: Research on Operational Amplifier Design Based on GMID
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: This paper delves into the pivotal role of operational amplifiers in analog integrated circuit design, especially in the context of continuous technological advancements, shrinking transistor sizes, and decreasing power supply voltages. Designing an operational amplifier that meets specified requirements has become increasingly crucial. The paper introduces the gm/id design methodology, which shifts the design focus from manual calculations to the use of simulation software, primarily relying on spice models and EDA tools, balancing power consumption, gain, linearity, and noise in a multidimensional manner. By examining a conventional two-stage operational amplifier (consisting of a five-transistor OTA in the first stage and a common-source amplifier in the second stage) designed using DB 135nm technology and EDA Cadence 617, the feasibility and effectiveness of the gm/id design approach are demonstrated.

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis of Motor Bearing based on Multi-Feature Fusion
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: Aiming at the loss of single sensor signal and low fault identification rate in mining motor bearings, a fault diagnosis algorithm based on the fusion of multiple sensor signals is proposed. First, multiple time domain and frequency domain fault features are extracted for each vibration signal. Secondly, the maximum relevance and minimum redundancy (<tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$m$</tex>RMR) algorithm is used to screen the key features and reduce the feature redundancy. Finally, the golden jackal optimization algorithm (GJO) improved by Cauchy variation and weight decision is used to optimize the penalty factor and kernel function parameters in the support vector machine (SVM) model, so that it can be better applied in the fault diagnosis of motor bearings. Experimental results show that the proposed mRMR-IGJO-SVM model has higher accuracy, stability and faster convergence.

articleTitle: A Chaotic Encryption-Based Wireless Secure Transmission System for Satellite Communication
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: To address the pressing issue of privacy protection in satellite communication, we propose an interception-resistant communication module leveraging a four-dimensional Lorenz chaotic system. This module, implemented using the AD9361 platform for wireless transmission and reception, successfully encrypts and transmits various data types, including images and text, through Differential Quadrature Phase Shift Keying (DQPSK) modulation. At the receiving end, the system reliably decrypts and reconstructs the transmitted data. Simulation and design evaluations confirm the reliability of the encryption algorithm, demonstrating a robust key space of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$2^{600}$</tex> and a bit error rate (BER) of less than <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$10^{-9}$</tex>, which underscores its hardware viability and potential for application in secure satellite communication.

articleTitle: Track Fastener Detection Method Based on Improved Yolov8s Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: Railway fasteners play a crucial role in connecting the track to the sleepers, and their performance is vital for the stability of the track structure and the safety of train operations. Traditional detection methods primarily rely on human experience, which can be inefficient and susceptible to human error. This paper proposes a novel method for railway fastener detection based on YOLOv8s. By incorporating the DAS dynamic convolution module and EMA attention mechanism modules, the method effectively filters out irrelevant background information, allowing the model to focus on critical areas within the image without increasing computational overhead. Experimental results indicate that the improved model demonstrates superior recognition performance for railway fasteners in complex environments. This research not only significantly improve the efficiency and accuracy of detecting the integrity of railway fasteners, but also ensure the safety and reliability of railway transportation.

articleTitle: Research on Wireless Dynamic Magnetic Resonance Charging Technology for Autonomous Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: In response to the significant issues of low charging efficiency and insufficient system stability in autonomous vehicles during operation, a solution based on wireless dynamic magnetic resonance technology has been researched. To address this problem, methods for system architecture optimization, hardware design improvement, and control strategy adjustment have been proposed, effectively analyzing charging performance and system stability under different vehicle speeds and complex road conditions. The wireless dynamic magnetic resonance charging technology enhances charging efficiency, improves system stability, and extends driving range, achieving efficient energy transfer and smooth system operation during dynamic charging. Simulation results indicate that this solution demonstrates good adaptability under various operating conditions, leading to more stable system operation and the capability to solve the dynamic charging challenges of autonomous vehicles. The results show that this technological solution is feasible and has practical application potential.

articleTitle: Dual PID Precision Temperature Control System Based on Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: In the process of industrial production, the precise control of temperature is widely used in pharmaceutical, chemical, biological and other fields, but along with the demand for energy saving and energy utilization, this paper is based on RT-thread IoT real-time operating system, designed a program using two-layer PID precise control of heating furnace and implementation, aimed at improving the responsiveness of the system and the precision of the temperature control, in order to realize the high efficiency of energy control. The PID algorithm is widely used in industrial control field, which can be applied to different scenarios but is easily affected by environmental factors in temperature control, so this paper proposes a two-layer PID, in which the inverse of the deviation value of the previous layer is used as a transfer parameter between the two layers of the PID to solve the instability of the ordinary PID used for the controlled object under different environmental temperatures.

articleTitle: Study on the Network Attack and Defense Application of Generative Artificial Intelligence in Power System
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: With the rapid development of information technology, the power system, as an important infrastructure, is facing severe threats from cyber-attacks. At the same time, the progress of artificial intelligence (AI) technology has brought about a wide range of applications in various fields. Generative artificial intelligence (GAI), as an important part of AI technology, can be applied to network attack and defense in the field of electric power and provide valuable suggestions and decision support for engineers. Firstly, the current problems faced by the power system and the rapid development of AI technology were introduced. Then, the significant position of GAI technology in nowadays AI field was discussed, and the large language models (LLMs) technology which was suitable for processing text data was chose to build an intelligent dialog platform. The steps of fine-tuning the LLMs were elaborated, focusing on how to build the exclusive large model belonging to the electric power domain, from dataset construction to final model merging, and the results were demonstrated. Finally, this study was summarized and future research directions were outlined.

articleTitle: Research on Digital Signal Denoising Techniques Based on Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: In recent years, convolutional neural networks (CNNs) have demonstrated considerable potential in the domain of digital signal denoising, effectively overcoming the constraints of conventional filtering and spectral methodologies. Digital signals are frequently subjected to a variety of noise interferences, which not only impair the signal quality but also introduce errors in the data. In this work, we propose a novel multi-level convolutional neural network (CNN) denoising architecture that combines residual learning and an attention mechanism to selectively amplify key features while removing noise. The model structure incorporates a dual transformation of the time domain and the frequency domain, enabling the capture of complex dependencies in diverse noise patterns through the use of dilated convolution and adaptive jump connection. Furthermore, a multi-scale feature fusion strategy has been devised with the objective of enhancing the denoising performance of the model at varying noise levels, thereby improving its robustness to different signal-to-noise ratios. The experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method exhibits a notable superiority over the current state-of-the-art denoising techniques in terms of signal fidelity and detail preservation. Furthermore, it is evident that the method is adaptable to a diverse range of noise scenarios.

articleTitle: Research on Key Technologies of Control-By-Wire System for Trackless Transportation Robot in Coal Mines
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: The high-quality development of the coal mining industry relies on the construction of smart mines and the support of core technologies related to coal mine intelligence. The high-quality development of the coal mining industry relies on the construction of smart mines and the support of core technologies related to coal mine intelligence. The 14th Five Year Plan proposes specific development goals to achieve 5G+smart mining, requiring technological innovation as the engine, digitization and intelligence as the main line, integrating resources to overcome a series of bottleneck

articleTitle: WSN Secure Routing Protocol Based on an Improved WOA Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: With the development and prospects of intelligent networks, the Internet of Things is becoming increasingly popular. It aims to utilize network edges to achieve intelligent services and evaluation of the Internet of Things. In addition, this utilization enhances the user experience, and ensures service resilience in the face of any disaster scenario. IoT devices deploy distributed structures that are more responsive, with better quality of service and proximity to end users.Nevertheless, security is primarily considered to be the sensitivity to resist attacks. This work aims to introduce a new secure routing model, it chooses and encrypts by the best path. Firstly, the optimal path or node is selected for secure transmission while performing the optimal link-state multiplexing route.To optimize path selection for destination and source, encryption is performed to ensure secure transmission. In this study, an improved WOA algorithm (IWOA) for security authentication was proposed.The simulation results show that the IWOA protocol not only chooses a safer path but also has fewer hops on average, so that the nodes have more energy left on average and energy consumption is more uniform. In addition, the IWOA protocol has a higher average packet loss rate, which means that it is faster than the WOA protocol in excluding malicious nodes from the network. In the face of wormhole attacks, the WOA protocol is powerless, but the IWOA protocol can quickly reduce the trust value of the wormhole and expel it from the network.

articleTitle: Research on Design and Implementation of a Domestic Intelligent Target Recognition System
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: The most prevalent object detection algorithms are predominantly developed using NVIDIA's Compute Unified Device Architecture (CUDA) and are optimised for NVIDIA hardware. In view of the growing complexity and volatility of the international security environment, there is a pressing need to accelerate the domestic development of critical systems. This study presents the design of a domestic, vehicle-mounted heterogeneous computing platform based on locally manufactured chips, with the objective of replacing foreign dependencies in artificial intelligence applications. The transfer of object detection algorithms from foreign chip architectures to domestic ones is underway, with the objective of ensuring compatibility and optimisation for local hardware. Comparative experiments demonstrate that the domestic intelligent object detection system not only achieves equivalent accuracy to comparable foreign systems but also delivers performance improvements of up to 73.11%. These findings highlight the potential of domestic technologies to not only meet but exceed the standards of foreign solutions in high-performance computing tasks that are essential for national security and technological autonomy.

articleTitle: Design and Simulation of a Smart Ward System Based on ARM and Proteus
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: With the rapid development of IoT and embedded technologies, the construction of smart wards has become a key focus in modern healthcare. This study aims to design a smart ward simulation system based on an ARM processor to address inefficiencies in traditional ward management, such as low manual monitoring efficiency and overlooked infusion monitoring. The system integrates multiple functional modules, including temperature and humidity monitoring, light intensity adjustment, infusion monitoring, call alarms, and fan control, creating an intelligent platform for ward environment management and patient status monitoring. By employing multi-sensor fusion technology for data acquisition and an incremental PID control algorithm for precise fan speed regulation, the system is tested using Proteus simulation software. Results indicate that all functional modules operate stably and respond quickly, ensuring ward comfort and safety while significantly improving the precision and efficiency of medical care. The system demonstrates advantages such as low cost and low complexity, providing strong technical support and theoretical basis for the practical deployment of smart wards.

articleTitle: Towards Automatic Detection of Confusion in MOOC Learner Feedback: A Natural Language Processing Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: Massive Open Online Courses (MOOCs) have become a popular form of online learning, providing learners around the world with access to high-quality educational content. During the online learning process, it is crucial for instructors to understand where learners are experiencing difficulties and confusion through learning feedback. However, analyzing large volumes of learner feedback manually can be time-consuming and resource-intensive, making it difficult for instructors to identify areas of confusion and provide targeted support. In this paper, we present RE-MOOC to automatically identifying feedback expressing confusion or difficulty in MOOC discussion forums. Our approach leverages retrieval-enhanced prompt learning, which combines the benefits of similarity retrieval with the power of a pre-trained Edu-BERT model. By retrieving the most similar feedbacks and embedding them into the input with prompt learning, RE-MOOC can learn to classify feedbacks expressing confusion more effectively. We evaluate our approach on a real-world dataset of learner feedback collected from a popular MOOC platform and achieve promising results. Our approach outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in all four metrics, achieving 93.94% in F1-score and 95% accuracy.

articleTitle: Scientific Physics-Informed Neural Networks on Silicon Membranes
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) have emerged as a promising approach for solving complex computational solid mechanics problems by integrating data and physical laws. In this study, we leverage PINNs to simulate the mechanical behavior of silicon-based MEMS membranes, which are crucial in various applications. Our approach involves training a PINN model with data from finite element simulations and the governing equations of linear elasticity. By incorporating the physical laws into the neural network's loss function, we ensure that the learned solution adheres to the underlying physics. The PINN architecture is designed to handle the specific boundary conditions and geometries of silicon membranes. The results demonstrate that our PINN model can accurately simulate the displacement and stress fields of the silicon membranes under various loading conditions. The predicted mechanical responses show excellent agreement with the reference finite element solutions, with a mean relative error of less than 1%. This high level of accuracy highlights the potential of PINNs as a powerful tool for simulating the mechanical behavior of silicon-based MEMS devices. The trained PINN model can be used for rapid design space exploration and optimization of high-performance silicon-based MEMS devices.

articleTitle: Modulation RecognitionTechnology Based on Feature Extraction
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: This paper explores modulation recognition technology based on feature extraction, which is a key means of identifying different modulation types of signals in modern communication systems. By preprocessing and feature extraction of the received signal, this technology can effectively extract key information from complex signal environments and identify the modulation mode of the signal. The paper first introduces the background and significance of modulation recognition technology, and then elaborates on the methods and steps of feature extraction, including various feature extraction techniques such as time domain, frequency domain, and high-order statistics. Subsequently, the paper discussed the effectiveness of different features in modulation recognition and verified the effectiveness of the proposed method through experiments. Finally, the advantages and challenges of modulation recognition technology based on feature extraction were summarized.

articleTitle: A PCIe-Based Inter-Processor Messaging Architecture
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: With the increasing number of processors in modern vehicles and the growing demand for inter-processor coordination, there is an urgent need for a high-performance, high-reliability one-to-many data transmission solution. Addressing the data transmission and messaging requirements between processor systems in automotive electronics, this paper designs and implements a PCIe-based messaging architecture for multiprocessor systems. By integrating scatter-gather DMA technology, the proposed solution significantly enhances both the efficiency and reliability of data transmission in multi-processor environments, providing a feasible and efficient approach to meet the increasingly complex data transmission needs in modern automotive electronics. Initially, this paper constructs a multi-host transmission architecture that does not rely on a PCIe switch by configuring one node in the multi-host system as an RC (Root Complex) controller and the remaining nodes as endpoint devices. Subsequently, based on this PCIe transmission architecture, a message publish-subscribe scheme is developed, which effectively organizes and schedules data transmission among multiple processors. Finally, by incorporating the scatter-gather DMA transmission method, the paper achieves unified message delivery from different publishing nodes, thereby improving transmission efficiency in scenarios involving non-contiguous message transfers. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed messaging architecture effectively satisfies the communication require-ments between processors, showcasing its practicality in real-world applications. The architecture exhibits superior performance in message transmission rates, achieving an approximately 27% improvement compared to traditional PCIe methods.

articleTitle: Multi-Modal Vision Transformer using Variable and Shifted Windows for MRI Reconstruction
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: Swin Transformer has become a paradigm for high-level vision tasks. However, its application in image reconstruction is hampered by the fixed window size and high-resolution feature maps, which restrict the extent of information extraction. In this work, we propose a novel multi-modal vision Transformer network using variable and shifted windows (MVSWT) to tackle the aforementioned challenges for accelerated MRI reconstruction. The variable and shifted windowing strategy achieves flexible local and long-range dependency modelling by focusing on multi-scope self-attention calculations. To fully leverage the multi-modality advantage of MRI, we construct a cross-modal information interaction architecture that incorporates the cross attention mechanism. Moreover, the introduction of data consistency (DC) operation enables the Transformer-based network to learn and estimate residual images for fast and accurate convergence. Qualitative and quantitative experimental results demonstrate that MVSWT reaches more competitive performance against other benchmark algorithms.

articleTitle: DETR with hybrid attention encoder for object detection
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: The effectiveness of introducing an attention mechanism to improve model performance and generalization has been demonstrated in various computer vision tasks. However, most of the existing attention mechanisms cannot fully fuse channel feature information and spatial feature information. In order to strike a balance between performance and computational complexity, this paper proposes Channel Spatial Hybrid Attention (CSHA) and Global Self Attention (GSA) to improve the performance of object detection networks. Among them, CSHA adopts a fusion structure of spatial attention and channel self-attention, which can integrate global channel features while extracting spatial features. GSA further integrates channel self-attention on the basis of splitting head to compute spatial self-attention. In addition, by introducing GSA and CSHA in RT-DETR encoder, we further propose DETR object detection network with hybrid attention encoder (HA-DETR). On the Tianchi Tile defect detection dataset, HA-DETR improves the mAP0.5 by 5.1% compared to RT-DETR, and CSHA improves the mAP by 2.1% and 2.9% compared to MLCA and EMA attention methods, respectively. On the Pascal VOC dataset, CSHA improves mAP0.5 by 1.1% compared to the CA attention mechanism and outperforms several other popular attention methods.

articleTitle: Design Of A High-Performance Timer Circuit For Adaptive On-Time Buck Converter
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: This paper presents a timer circuit designed for an adaptive on-time (AOT) Buck DC-DC converter. The circuit utilizes input voltage feedforward compensation and output feedback techniques to maintain a constant switching frequency despite fluctuations in input and output voltages, thereby achieving fixed-frequency pseudo pulse width modulation. The design is based on a 0.18 μm BCD process and is validated through Spectre simulations. The simulation results indicate that when the input voltage varies from 4V to 14V, the output voltage change will not exceed 18mV, and the output voltage recovery time is less than 12μs. Furthermore, when the load current jumps between 1A-2A, the output undershoot/overshoot voltage will not exceed 29m V, and the output voltage recovery time is within 27us. Additionally, the incorporation of input voltage feedforward technology enhances the speed of the input linear transient response.

articleTitle: Wireless Real-Time Health Monitoring System Based on STM32
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: A wireless health monitoring system was designed to address the problems of large size, long measurement time and complicated operation of traditional human health monitoring devices. The system takes the STM32 microcontroller as the core, uses the flexible temperature sensor made by the Electrohydrodynamic printing process to collect the human body temperature data, uses the MAX30102 heart rate oximetry sensor to collect the heart rate and oximetry data, and displays the human body data in real time through the OLED screen, and at the same time, the system uses the WIFI module to upload the human body data to the IoT platform, which achieves the remote real-time mobile APP Monitoring. The design is complemented by an early warning function, where the alarm module sends out an alarm signal when the collected human data exceeds the set range.

articleTitle: Research on Radio Propagation Model Based on Deep Learning and Feature Images
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: The radio propagation model based on deep learning can extract features from a large amount of relevant data and learn from them to adapt to the real-time computing requirements of complex environmental scenes. In this study, we construct a multi-dimensional feature dataset and develop a U-Net-based propagation model. To enhance the performance of the model, we introduce a feature classification preprocessing module before the model input to distinguish features with different physical meanings. Additionally, Atrous Spatial Pyramid Pooling is incorporated in the encoder to improve the model's ability to learn multi-scale features. Experiments are conducted on a dataset consisting of 275 cells in an urban area, using MAE, RMSE, and MAPE as evaluation metrics. The results demonstrate that our proposed model outperforms the original U-Net architecture in terms of all evaluation metrics for overall, indoor, and outdoor areas.

articleTitle: Design of High Performance Discrete Wavelet Transform Hardware Architecture for Star Sensor
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: In response to the limited hardware resources of star sensor, this paper proposes a high-performance two-dimensional Discrete Wavelet Transform (DWT) hardware architecture, with graph traversal and circuit structure optimization as the main directions. This architecture has the characteristics of high computational efficiency and low memory requirement. Firstly, the proposed architecture adopts a five point synchronous graph traversal method to read images as inputs to the transformer, which helps to improve computational efficiency. Secondly, design the filter circuit structure without multipliers and implement efficient timing node segmentation processing, so that the critical path delay can be comparable to the adder delay. Finally, Based on the improvement of FIFO scheduling algorithm, the transpose storage requirement is independent of the size of the read image. The DWT hardware architecture proposed in this article is described by VHDL language and implemented on Xilinx XC7Z100. The experimental results show that compared with the existing mainstream DWT architecture, this architecture reduces hardware resource usage by more than 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup> and has the least computation cycle consumption and the lowest critical path delay.

articleTitle: Tree Wideband Circularly Polarized Antenna Design for CPW Feeds
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: Compared with the traditional linearly polarized antenna, the circularly polarized antenna has a great practical application value, which can receive arbitrarily polarized linearly polarized waves or circularly polarized waves, and can be applied in satellite communications, Internet of Things, etc., and plays an important role in practical applications. In this paper, a CPW-fed tree-shaped broadband circularly polarized antenna is proposed, with the size of 50 × 50 × 0.8 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>, and the dielectric substrate is made of FR4. The antenna is fully equipped with good circularly polarized radiation characteristics in the operating band, and its impedance bandwidth can reach 77.03%, axial bandwidth is 81.19%, and the peak gains are all higher than 4.7 dB, which achieves a higher purity of circular polarization.

articleTitle: Reliability Study of Various Edge Terminations of Silicon Carbide Power Devices Using Simulation Methods
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: Reliability is one of the major concerns for SiC devices. A proper edge termination structure would enable SiC devices to operate at designed voltages because it mitigates the electric field aggregation caused by the cylindrical or spherical junctions. However, a great number of research has been reported on studying the optimization of edge terminations to achieve higher breakdown voltage (BV). In contrast, research on the impact of edge termination design on devices' reliability remains limited. In this work, floating field ring (FFR), single-zone junction termination extension (SZ-JTE), ring-assisted JTE (RA-JTE), multi-floating zone JTE (MFZ-JTE), and Hybrid-JTE are studied. Their reliability performance is evaluated by comparing the BV stability of these termination designs under different implantation doses, critical dimension (CD) deviations, and fixed SiC/SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> interface charge through technology computer-aided design (TCAD) simulations. Among all the edge terminations listed, Hybrid-JTE has exhibited a champion reliability.

articleTitle: Short-Term Power Prediction of Wind Power Based on Optimal Wavelet Threshold Denoising
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: In this paper, a new short-term forecasting model for wind power is proposed. Firstly, the wavelet threshold denoising method is used to process the data, and the optimal number of wavelet decomposition layers is determined by experiments. Secondly, the moss growth algorithm is used to optimize the hyperparameters of BiLSTM, and the preliminary prediction of wind power is completed. Finally, the error correction strategy is introduced to correct the preliminary prediction results of wind power. The proposed method is verified by the actual data, which proves its rationality and effectiveness.

articleTitle: A Multiple Precision Floating-Point Arithmetic Unit Based on the RISC-V Instruction Set
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: With the advancements in image processing and machine learning, greater challenges have been posed to parallel computing, especially in the realm of floating-point arithmetic. In the face of increasingly complex application scenarios, single-precision floating-point units (FPUs) are becoming increasingly inadequate in terms of flexibility and versatility. Therefore, this paper proposes a design for a multi-precision floating-point unit. The FPU of this design supports multiple precision formats including fp32, fp16, fp8, and variable precision fp16, achieving high multi-precision flexibility. This design effectively reduces the calculation cycle while ensuring efficient execution performance, meeting the diverse needs for calculation accuracy in different application scenarios. In addition to basic arithmetic functions, this design also implements single instruction multiple data (SIMD) functionality, further enhancing the processing power and efficiency of the arithmetic unit. Meanwhile this design introduces a series of custom simd_fmt instructions, expanding the RISC-V instruction set to enable it to support a wider range of computational operations. These instructions exhibit significant performance advantages when dealing with multithreaded tasks and vector operations.

articleTitle: High-Precision Hybrid Power Modeling for Virtual Prototype Platforms Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: Energy efficiency is essential in system-on-chip (SoC) design, with early-stage power analysis crucial for effectively exploring the design space. However, current methods struggle to accurately predict power consumption for multi-modules in the SoC in high-level simulations. This paper introduces a hybird power modeling framework based on machine learning methods, which can be integrated into the RISC-V virtual prototype (VP) to provide accurate power estimation at the electronic system level (ESL). First, this methodology supports the modeling of both leakage and dynamic power for the three major modules of a SoC (CPU, bus and memory). Subsequently, a broad set of modeling features is identified based on the working mechanism of the RISC-V VP, followed by the application of sequential forward selection. Finally, advanced regression techniques are applied to enhance the accuracy of the modeling results. The dynamic power models for the CPU, bus, and memory modules achieved mean absolute percentage errors (MAPEs) of 5.81%, 6.75%, and 16.90%, respectively, while the leakage power models exhibit MAPEs consistently below 5%.

articleTitle: Industrial Process Fault Diagnosis Based on MTF-SE-ResNet
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: The industrial production process is a dynamic and complex system. To address the high-dimensional nonlinear issues in production process data, this paper proposes a fault diagnosis method based on Markov Transfer Field (MTF), Squeeze-and-Excitation Network (SENet), and Residual Network (ResNet). The study focuses on Tennessee Eastman (TE) process data, converting time-series data into images through MTF to retain dynamic dependency features. Subsequently, features are extracted and channel weights are adjusted using a ResNet embedded with the SE module, significantly enhancing feature recognition capability. Experimental results demonstrate that this model exhibits excellent accuracy and robustness in TE fault diagnosis, making it suitable for detecting multi-class complex faults.

articleTitle: A Method for Implementing Basic Block Reordering in GNU 1D
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: Currently, basic block reordering optimizations are typically performed during the compilation stage or implemented through standalone tools, with no direct implementation in the linker (ld). This paper proposes a method to implement basic block reordering directly within the Binutils ld linker. By inputting data on basic block sizes, call relationships, and jump frequencies, this approach combines this information with a basic block reordering algorithm to generate a new sequence for basic blocks. Based on this new sequence, it modifies the size, content, symbol table, and relocation table within the. text section of the target file. When executed according to this reordered sequence, the program reduces cache misses and the overhead associated with loading and unloading. Experimental results show that, using gzip as an example, this optimization reduces i-cache misses by 1.45%, i-TLB misses by 0.17%, and branch miss rate by 3.35%, demonstrating the feasibility and effectiveness of implementing basic block reordering within GNU Id.

articleTitle: Construction of Object-Oriented Reverse Analysis and Design Model for the rCore Operating System
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: Software document is a file that records the composition and workflow of software, and it is an important basis for software maintenance and development. At present, we have the source program of the rCore operating system, but there is no document about the program composition and workflow. In this paper, based on the source program, the module files of the system are analyzed, and the object-oriented composition model and the cooperation model between module functions of the rCore operating system are generated in reverse, which completes the reverse engineering work of the system and lays the foundation for the continuous development and maintenance of the system.

articleTitle: Reinforcement Learning Based Container Placement Strategies
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: In recent years, with the rapid development of cloud computing technology, the field of cloud computing has given rise to the emerging architecture of Container-as-a-Service (CaaS), which has been widely used as soon as it was introduced.CaaS not only provides higher flexibility, portability, and resource utilisation efficiency through containerisation, but also helps to expand the scale of cloud computing applications. However, with the wide application of CaaS, the energy consumption problem brought by it should not be ignored. Since there is a strong connection between energy consumption under CaaS and the load state of the VMs on which containers depend, effective placement of containers can be done by considering the load state of the VMs to reduce the meaningless energy consumption. Most of the current strategies are based on heuristic and meta-heuristic algorithms to solve the container placement problem, which tend to perform poorly in CaaS architectures and are prone to fall into local optima. In order to solve the above problems, this paper proposes a container placement strategy based on improved Q-Learning. By introducing an ε-greedy strategy and qualification traces similar to the simulated annealing idea in Q-Learning, the containers are placed with the goal of high VM utilisation and quality of service, and the combination of idle VM migration and physical shutdown strategy optimises the energy consumption of the computing cluster, so as to achieve the goal of energy saving and emission reduction. Experimental results in the extended CloudSim simulation platform show that compared with other algorithms, the algorithm proposed in this paper has better energy-saving effect and maintains a low service violation rate.

articleTitle: Research on Photovoltaic Prediction and Load Voltage Regulation Based on Transformer
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: In recent years, with the widespread application of renewable energy, solar photovoltaic power generation has gradually been widely integrated into medium and low voltage distribution networks. Photovoltaic power generation poses greater risks to the transmission system, and new power systems require photovoltaic output prediction and voltage regulation. This article first uses Pearson correlation analysis to screen the main factors that have a significant impact on photovoltaic power, and then establishes a neural network method based on Transformer structure as input for photovoltaic power prediction. The power flow calculation method uses predicted photovoltaic output and some line parameters to calculate active and reactive power, ensuring stable operation of distribution lines. All experimental data in this article were collected in real-time from the Tongwei area of Gansu Province, and were divided into training and testing sets. This method reduces the relative error of photovoltaic output prediction to 13.32% and can effectively regulate voltage.

articleTitle: Construction and Application of Robo-Advisory System Based on Knowledge Graph
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: This study constructs an intelligent investment advisor system based on a knowledge graph to address the complex decision-making needs in financial markets. By integrating natural language processing (NLP) technology and a graph database, the system effectively extracts and analyzes entities and relationships in the investment domain. Experimental results demonstrate that personalized optimization strategies significantly improve the accuracy and response speed of investment recommendations.

articleTitle: A Low Overhead Time Slot Synchronization Mechanism for Wireless Ad Hoc Network
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: This paper addresses the issues of time synchronization and timeslot synchronization in Ad Hoc networks. It proposes a distributed, low-overhead, and highprecision synchronization algorithm that utilizes baseband hardware to address the time of received wireless frames, implements hop-by-hop distributed synchronization based on gradient diffusion. Compared to traditional algorithms, this approach significantly improves synchronization accuracy, achieving microsecond-level precision. The algorithm is distributed, with its communication overhead and computational complexity only dependent on the number of one-hop neighbor nodes. The overhead introduced by synchronization messages is on the order of 100 bps.

articleTitle: A Reconfigurable Polarization Converter Based on Multilayer Metasurface Structure for 5G and Satellite Communication
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: To address the demand for different polarizations of electromagnetic waves in various communication methods, we present a reconfigurable transmission polarization converter. The device is based on a multilayer metasurface and metallic grating structure, with diodes control for functional state switching. It can achieve two functional states: linear-to-linear polarization conversion and linear-to-circular polarization conversion, corresponding to the polarization requirements of electromagnetic waves in 5G and satellite communication, respectively. It enables cross-polarization conversion within the 1.55 to 3.29 GHz and 3.82 to 5.50 GHz ranges, as well as linear-to-circular polarization conversion across multiple frequency bands within the 1.34 to 2.64 GHz range. The performance of the polarization converter is validated through simulations. Given its operating frequency bandwidth, this device has potential applications in 5G and satellite communication.

articleTitle: Research on Incremental Linking Method of Gold Linker Based on LoongArch Architecture
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: This paper investigates the implementation of incremental linking for the Gold linker on the LoongArch architecture. The Gold linker, part of the GNU-Binutils package, is an efficient linker for the ELF file format, and its incremental linking feature significantly reduces the time required for program relinking during development, thereby improving development efficiency. To address challenges related to the layout and space constraints of the Global Offset Table and Procedure Linkage Table when implementing incremental linking on LoongArch, this paper proposes solutions and extends the Gold linker to meet the architectural requirements of LoongArch. Experimental results show that with incremental linking, the linking time is significantly reduced, with incremental update time being approximately 40% faster than the initial linking. Compared to the traditional ld linker, the initial linking time is reduced by about 50%, while incremental update time sees an improvement of up to 70%. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of incremental linking in enhancing development efficiency and shortening the development cycle.

articleTitle: A Cooperative Spectrum Sensing Method Based on Complex Evidence Theory and Multi-Angle Weights to Defend Against SSDF
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: To ensure satisfactory sensing performance in cooperative spectrum sensing even when subjected to Spectrum Sensing Data Falsification (SSDF) attacks, when the proportion of malicious users (MUs) is less than 50%, a cooperative spectrum sensing method is proposed, based on complex evidence theory and multi-angle weights (CETMW-CSS). First, secondary users (SUs) calculate their respective basic probability assignment (BPA) using locally obtained statistics. The BPA is mapped onto the complex plane during the iterative process of acquiring reputation values, and the complex Belief Hellinger (BH) distance is calculated. The reputation values, distance function, and signal-to-noise ratio are then integrated as weights to modify the BPA, reducing the influence of MUs. Simulations demonstrate that, compared to existing methods, this approach offers superior resistance to SSDF attacks.

articleTitle: Design of Adaptive Multipath Suppression Receiver in High Dynamic Environment
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: Under high dynamic conditions, the signal carrier will generate significant Doppler frequency shift, and due to high-speed movement, it will lead to more obvious multipath effects. At this time, tracking errors will increase or even lose lock, posing a serious challenge to GNSS receivers. In order to overcome the problem of multipath in high dynamic environments and improve the performance of receivers, this paper proposes a vector tracking algorithm based on Strobe correlators. Firstly, the design of Strobe correlators is used to mitigate the impact of multipath on the code loop and the resulting pseudorange measurement values in each channel. Then, Kalmannet is used to extract Doppler frequency to assist the receiver in improving performance under high dynamic conditions. Simulation results show that this method is feasible.

articleTitle: Design and Measurement of an Actuator Based on a DC Motor
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: As astronomical telescopes continue to increase in aperture size, they often employ active reflective surface technology, and actuators are key components in deforming the active reflective surfaces, always remaining a research hotspot. A type of actuator based on a DC motor has been developed, which uses a brushless DC motor as the driving element and a ball screw as the transmission mechanism, proposing the addition of a laser distance sensor to detect displacement in real-time. The motion accuracy and load capacity of the actuator are important technical indicators. This paper conducts performance tests from these two aspects. The results show that the designed actuator can achieve a motion accuracy of 0.2mm under no-load conditions and 0.24mm under a load of 129N. This verifies that the proposed actuator meets the requirements of high precision, large stroke, and high load, providing technical reserves for the design of large-aperture astronomical telescopes in China in the future.

articleTitle: Multi-Station Electronic Reconnaissance Periodic Task Planning Method
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: In the existing distributed cooperative electronic reconnaissance scenario, periodic task scheduling only considers two dimensions: time and frequency. As the number of stations in the distributed cooperative electronic reconnaissance system increases, introducing the station dimension for finer differentiation of task execution stations can enhance task capacity and execution benefits under limited resources. However, after introducing the station dimension, the time alignment requirements of multi-station tasks render traditional single-station time resource constraints inadequate for expressing true multi-station temporal constraints. Inspired by the buddy system of operating systems and based on the characteristics of multi-station periodic tasks, this paper introduces the concept of time fragments and proposes a method for determining cooperative station time constraints, ultimately establishing a multi-station periodic task scheduling model aimed at maximizing execution benefits.

articleTitle: A High-Precision Low-Power Adaptive Zero Current Detector for DC-DC Converters with Offset Autozero and Delay Compensation
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: This brief introduces a high-precision, low-power adaptive zero-current detector (ZCD) with offset autozero, dynamic biasing control, and delay compensation for DC-DC converters.The proposed ZCD detects the zero crossing point of inductor current by measuring the voltage drop across the power switch. A three-stage comparator with auto-zero for each stage is proposed to enhance the intrinsic offset cancellation, thus to improve the detection accuracy. By injecting a known offset current into the ZCD, the driver's delay of the power switch could be compensated, which improves the detection accuracy further. Additionally, by incorporating dynamic biasing control, the overall power consumption of the ZCD is reduced significantly. To demonstrate the proposed ZCD, a BUCK converter was fabricated under 0.18µm BCD process. The active area of the proposed ZCD is only 0.015mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>. The measured quiescent current of the ZCD is as low as 750nA, and the reverse current can be controlled within 20mA.

articleTitle: Path Planning of Mobile Robot Based on the Improved A* Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of low efficiency of path retrieval and insufficient safety of planned path for mobile robot in complex indoor environment, a path planning method based on improved A* algorithm is proposed. Firstly, aiming at the complex indoor environment where mobile robots often need to work in, the evaluation function of the A* algorithm is improved to shorten the time of calculating the path. Secondly, the redundant points of the generated path were optimized by the method of inflection point validity detection, so that the path distance is shorter and the turning point is reduced. Finally, considering the safety problem, a dual-path obstacle avoidance method is proposed to keep a safe distance between the robot and the obstacles. The experimental results prove the effectiveness of the improved algorithm.

articleTitle: The Research on Malicious Load Recognition Based on Principal Component Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: As household electrical loads become increasingly diverse and electricity demand continues to rise, the identification of malicious loads has become a critical area of focus in smart grid research. Existing approaches primarily concentrate on current signal processing and the application of machine learning algorithms. Existing approaches, however, face limitations when dealing with complex nonlinear relationships and noise interference, particularly in diverse load environments. To address these challenges, this paper introduces a novel method for malicious load identification based on Principal Component Analysis (PCA) and waveform image generation. The primary innovation of this approach lies in the transformation of current data into waveform images, facilitating enhanced feature extraction and classification. First, the current data is converted into waveform images to visually represent malicious load characteristics. Due to the high dimensionality and redundancy, PCA is used for dimensionality reduction, preserving key features while removing noise and improving efficiency. Given the small sample size and complexity of malicious load data, the K-nearest neighbor (KNN) algorithm is applied for classification. KNN excels in small-sample environments by classifying based on similarity, making it ideal for handling the non-linear characteristics of malicious loads. The combination of PCA and KNN enables effective identification of malicious loads in high-dimensional, small-sample data. Experimental validation demonstrates that the proposed method delivers superior classification performance, achieving an accuracy of 0.9845, significantly surpassing the SVM classifier's 0.9617. These findings underscore the robustness and effectiveness of the waveform image-based approach for malicious load identification. The method offers promising new insights for smart grid monitoring and represents a significant advancement in the accurate and efficient identification of malicious loads in diverse electrical systems. Additionally, the relatively small size of the model makes it suitable for deployment on edge devices, enabling real-time identification of malicious loads.

articleTitle: Design of Digital Modulation for Long Distance Optical Communication
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: Optical communication plays a key role in today's life. Achieving efficient and reliable long-distance communication through optical fibers has long been an important problem. This study primarily employs computer simulations to model long-distance fiber optic communication. Different modulation methods are simulated to analyze the effects of noise during signal transmission over fiber optics. The study calculates and compares the maximum transmission distances achievable within specified bit error rate (BER) ranges using various modulation techniques. The aim is to provide insights into selecting suitable modulation methods for long-distance fiber optic communication, ensuring that the signals can be transmitted over long distances within acceptable error rates while maintaining adequate transmission efficiency.

articleTitle: A Lightweight Space Target Detection Network
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: Space target detection represents a pivotal technology for environmental awareness in space. In order to address the challenge of achieving an optimal balance between detection accuracy and efficiency for optical images, we propose the use of a lightweight space target detection network based on the RT-DETR model. The EfficientViT backbone network is employed initially in order to significantly reduce the model parameters and computation. Subsequently, the CIoU loss function is employed to compensate for the decline in accuracy. The proposed model has a parameter count of 6.01M, representing a reduction of 58.8% compared to the baseline model. Computation is 13.5G, a decrease of 60.3 %. Furthermore, the model achieves an FPS of 97.32. In comparison to YOLOv10s, the proposed method demonstrates comparable accuracy in the space target dataset while exhibiting superior efficiency in all evaluated metrics.

articleTitle: Research on Parts Production Decision Making Based on Undominated Genetic Algorithm and Bloodsucking Leech Optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: Modern manufacturing companies face the challenges of production cost, quality control and benefit maximization in the production of high-tech products. In this paper, a spare parts inspection planning model based on 0–1 planning is proposed, aiming at reasonable quality and cost control. The model is solved using a non-dominated genetic algorithm combined with a blood-sucking leech optimization algorithm to minimize the total cost while ensuring supply chain efficiency and product quality. In addition, the article provides a comprehensive analysis of the defective rate, inspection cost and market feedback of spare parts, and proposes targeted decision-making strategies based on the experimental results, emphasizing the importance of improving product quality and customer satisfaction in the midst of fierce competition.

articleTitle: An Improved Adaptive Enhancement Algorithm for Low-Light Images
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: In the domain of low-light image enhancement, a critical challenge lies in simultaneously enhancing details and suppressing noise, while effectively improving brightness and contrast. Aiming at the factors that affect the low-light image enhancement effect, an improved adaptive enhancement algorithm for low-light images is proposed. Firstly, a double plateaus histogram equalization algorithm with adaptive selection of upper and lower thresholds is used to adaptively enhance image details and limit the generation of noise; Then the equalized image is used as the input image and the guide image, and guided filtering is performed on it to achieve the purpose of enhancing edge details and suppressing noise. Experimental results show that this algorithm significantly improves the brightness and contrast of the original image, and increases the image's information entropy by 47.3%. Compared with the adaptive double plateaus histogram equalization algorithm, the improved adaptive enhancement algorithm for low-light images increases the peak signal-to-noise ratio value and the structural similarity value of the image by 3.9% and 16.7<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup> respectively, indicating that the algorithm has certain practical application value.

articleTitle: Large Language Model (LLM) Text Generation Detection: A BERT-BiLSTM Approach with Attention Mechanisms
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: With the enhancement of Large Language Models (LLMs) performance, the demand for reliable methods to distinguish AI-generated text from human-written content is steadily growing. This study presents a novel detection framework based on a hybrid architecture integrating BERT, BiLSTM, and Talking-Heads Attention mechanisms. By leveraging BERT's contextual embedding capabilities, BiLSTM's sequential dependency capture, and an enhanced attention layer, the proposed model achieves significant improvements in classification accuracy and robustness. Experiments conducted on the GPT Reddit Dataset (GRiD) demonstrate the efficacy of the model, achieving an accuracy of 98.5% and an F1-score of 96.3%, outperforming many models such as SVM, ALBERT, and RoBERTa. The findings indicate that this approach successfully addresses the challenges posed by increasingly human-like text generated by advanced LLMs, offering a promising solution for maintaining digital content integrity.

articleTitle: Analysis of Optimization and Improvement of Massive MIMO Signal Detection Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: Massive MIMO (Multiple-Input Multiple-Output) technology hugely enhances spectral and energy efficiency in wireless communication systems, but signal detection remains a key challenge due to its high computational complexity. Traditional methods like Maximum Likelihood detection offer optimal performance but are not practical for large-scale systems due to exponential complexity growth. This paper analyzes four types of signal detection algorithms for massive MIMO: iterative optimization algorithms, deep learning-based methods, message passing and iterative soft threshold techniques, and Neumann series expansion. For each category, we explore their strengths and limitations, and propose optimization strategies such as adaptive adjustment mechanisms, hardware acceleration, model compression, and parallel computing to improve performance and computational efficiency.

articleTitle: SOFNet: A Salient Object-Enhanced Image Fusion Network
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: Image fusion tasks can infuse images with abundant information and enhance the performance of higher-level visual tasks. We propose a salient object-enhanced image fusion network, termed SOFNet. The network is designed to preserve detailed textures and color information of the background in source images while enhancing the thermal structural information of salient objects. Initially, we construct a convolutional neural network tailored for image fusion that can extract features from infrared and visible light source images to produce new fusion images. Additionally, we designed three loss functions: the color detail texture loss function, the thermal structural loss function, and the salient object loss function. Numerous experiments on various public datasets, along with our benchmark tests, show that our method not only creates visually appealing fused images but also surpasses state-of-the-art approaches in object detection mAP.

articleTitle: A 23-30GHz 6-Bit High-Accuracy VGA with 0.5dB ATT
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: This paper presents a 6-bit high-accuracy VGA suitable for phased array system. A combination of passive T-attenuator unit and active current-steering structure VGA is proposed to improve gain accuracy.
