The parallel compensation capacitor structure is added to the attenuator, and the cross-coupling capacitor structure is added to the current-steering VGA to further reduce the phase shift variation of the circuit. The VGA works in 23-30GHz, using 6-bit control word to achieve a gain step of 0.5dB and a gain variation range of 17dB. The maximum gain is 9.4dB, the gain error is less than 0.14dB, and the phase shift variation is less than ±2.95 °.

articleTitle: Design and Application of Safety Management System for Small-Scale Operation of Electricity Marketing Based on APP for Handheld Terminal
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: For emergency repair, meter installation and connection and other electricity marketing meter exchange operation sites, this paper designs a safety management system for small-scale operation of electricity marketing based on APP for handheld terminal. The system realizes the standardization of the operation process, and carries out security monitoring of the site operators and the operation process through artificial intelligence recognition algorithms, so as to solve the safety risk in the middle of the incident and greatly reduce the safety risk of the site operation. After the design and development of the system, the application results are remarkable, with practical application value and prospects for wide application.

articleTitle: Effects of Different Wind Speeds on the Leakage and Diffusion of LNG Trucks in Tunnels
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: This paper conducts a numerical simulation focusing on Liquefied Natural Gas (LNG) tanker leakage within tunnels, investigating the influence of wind speed on the leakage and dispersion. The results indicate that as wind speed increases, the gas cloud disperses further downstream with higher concentrations; additionally, the greater the atmospheric turbulence effect, the faster the heat transfer rate of both gas and droplets becomes, leading to an accelerated evaporation rate of the droplets. This research provides a scientific basis for emergency rescue operations in the event of LNG leakage, offering practical guidance and significance.

articleTitle: A Double Gaussian Denoising Method for Beam Profiling in Proton Therapy
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: The beam position and size are critical for the safety of the proton therapy system. In view of the distortion of data collected by the ionization chamber during radiating, the possible physical process of noise generation is analyzed and a denoising method based on double Gaussian fitting is proposed for beam profiling in this paper. To investigate the effect of air scattering on the distortion of measured data, we performed the simulation analysis of the process after the proton beam enters the ionization chamber using Garfield++. It was found that the double Gaussian denoising method has obvious advantages over the simple single Gaussian fitting.

articleTitle: A Fast Analytical Dose Calculation Approach Based on RAMDIM in MR-Guided Proton Therapy
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: In magnetic resonance-guided proton therapy, protons are deflected in magnetic fields, resulting in distortion of the dose distribution. In dose calculation, Monte Carlo simulation methods are highly accurate but time-consuming. Clinical dose validation requires a fast and accurate method to calculate the dose distribution. In this paper, a fast analytical dose calculation approach is proposed based on Raytracing Algorithm for Magnetic Deflection of Ions in Media. Different energies, different magnetic field strengths and different energy spreads are considered, and the <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\gamma$</tex>-pass rates in all cases exceeds 98%.

articleTitle: Adaptive Virtual Impedance-Based Control Strategy for Auxiliary Converters
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: Due to the difference in the impedance of the auxiliary converter line, the application of traditional droop control leads to the problem of unreasonable power distribution in parallel systems. In this paper, an adaptive virtual impedance control strategy to improve droop control is proposed. In this strategy, the proportional and integral links are introduced into the traditional droop control, and a new droop control is constructed, which can effectively coordinate the inherent contradiction between the power balancing accuracy and the output voltage drop. On this basis, the adaptive virtual impedance is constructed, which can improve the accuracy of power balancing and achieve power balancing. The simulation results show the effectiveness and feasibility of the proposed control strategy in the system power allocation.

articleTitle: Real-Time Detection of Anomalous Driving Behavior Using Generative Adversarial Networks and Behavior Prediction Models
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: In light of the accelerated advancement of autonomous driving technology, the assurance of the system's security and dependability has emerged as a pivotal concern. One of the principal challenges in this regard is the real-time detection of abnormal driving behaviour, which is essential for the avoidance of accidents and system failures. In this work, we propose a real-time detection framework based on a Generative Adversarial Network (GAN) and a behaviour prediction model with the objective of identifying abnormal behaviours in autonomous vehicles. Generative adversarial networks are employed to ascertain the distributions of typical driving behaviour and to generate realistic driving data. Meanwhile, behaviour prediction models are utilised to anticipate the anticipated behaviour of the vehicle based on historical sensor inputs and environmental context. The specific methods include the use of a generative network to simulate normal driving trajectories and a discriminant network to identify the differences between the real and generated data. Furthermore, the behaviour prediction model employs a more sophisticated deep learning architecture to capture intricate driving behaviour patterns and to compare them with real-time observed behaviours. When a significant deviation is identified, an anomaly alert is triggered. The efficacy of the model in detecting anomalous driving behaviours with high precision and low latency has been validated through a substantial number of experiments conducted on both simulated and real-world driving datasets.

articleTitle: Framework Design and Theoretical Research on Abstract Account Gas Payment Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: In order to solve the limitations of externally held accounts (EOA) and contract accounts (CA), Ethereum proposed to combine the two and design an abstract account, which can both initiate transactions and execute code. The Gas payment mechanism of abstract accounts has the risk of user information leakage. In order to solve the problem of user privacy, this paper proposes to use zero-knowledge proof (ZKP) to strengthen user privacy protection, and designs a technical framework for the interaction between Dapps and abstract account wallets; in order to meet the needs of multi-circuit and high efficiency, zero-knowledge proof is combined with BLS technology, and a Gas payment scheme based on proof aggregation and BLS signature (GP-PABLS) is designed; finally, the feasibility and efficiency of the experimental test scheme are designed, which improves the privacy and friendliness of users, provides theoretical and technical guidance for the development of abstract accounts and Gas payment mechanisms, and further promotes the development and improvement of blockchain applications.

articleTitle: Energy Consumption Load Prediction Through TCN Combined with Attention Mechanism Based on CEEMDAN
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: To improve the accuracy of short-term load forecasting and solve the problem of signal noise interference, the energy consumption load prediction method is proposed. In this paper, the Complete Ensemble Empirical Mode Decomposition with Adaptive Noise (CEEMDAN) algorithm is used to decompose the original sequence. Then, a TCN-Attention prediction model is designed by combining Temporal Convolutional Network (TCN) with attention mechanism for feature extraction and enhancement. Finally, the prediction results of each modal component are accumulated to obtain the final prediction result. The results show that this model has high prediction accuracy.

articleTitle: Design of Photovoltaic Irrigation System Based on Meteorological Data
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: In order to overcome the problems of photovoltaic irrigation system affected by weather fluctuations and high energy storage cost, the stable operation of irrigation system and the effective utilization of water resources are realized. This paper designs a photovoltaic irrigation system based on meteorological data. The system uses meteorological data combined with crop growth environment data to optimize irrigation strategy, and adopts intelligent regulation of photovoltaic power generation to ensure that the irrigation strategy matches the actual demand and improves the efficiency of the system. In addition, pumped storage energy storage is used to store excess photovoltaic power, solve the problem of energy fluctuations, and improve the reliability and stability of the irrigation system. After experimental tests, the system can ensure the stability of crop growth at the same time, improve system energy efficiency by 10%.

articleTitle: Three-Dimensional Path Planning of Unmanned Aerial Vehicle Based on Hybrid Strategy and Improved Dung Beetle Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: As an effective path exploration technology, dung Beetle algorithm has been widely used in the path planning of unmanned aerial vehicle autonomous navigation. In this paper, a 3D path planning strategy for unmanned aerial vehicles (UAS) is proposed by optimizing the dung beetle algorithm, aiming to overcome the challenges of local optimal traps, redundant turning points and low convergence efficiency encountered by traditional intelligent bionic algorithms when dealing with complex spatial path planning of UAS. First, based on mathematical modeling technology, we built a three-dimensional simulation environment of mountain terrain, and precisely set the objective function and constraint conditions of the UAV to ensure the authenticity and practicability of the experiment scene. We innovatively introduced Fuch and Logistic chaotic mapping mechanisms to optimize the initial population allocation of the dung beetle algorithm, which significantly enhanced the global exploration capability of the algorithm. At the same time, we designed an adaptive nonlinear decline strategy to dynamically regulate the number of dung beetles in different stages of the algorithm, thus accelerating the convergence process of the algorithm. In addition, in order to achieve smooth transition of the path, we use Bessel curve technology to perform fine processing on the generated path.

articleTitle: Quality Inspection of Spot Welding in Automotive Production Lines Based on Visual Images
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: Spot welding plays a crucial role in automotive manufacturing, significantly impacting vehicle performance and structural integrity. To ensure quality control in car body welding, machine vision-based automatic detection of spot welds has emerged as an effective solution. However, traditional image processing methods often struggle with environmental disturbances and lack robustness. To address these challenges, we propose an innovative network model for small object detection, specifically designed to identify and assess spot weld position and quality on car bodies. Our approach builds upon the established YOLOv5 architecture, incorporating several key enhancements. We integrate the lightweight MobileNetV3 network as the backbone, replacing YOLOv5's original structure to optimize both accuracy and real-time performance. To improve small object detection capabilities, we introduce a novel feature pyramid network with efficient cross-scale connections, enabling rapid and effective multiscale feature fusion. Quantitative evaluations on a comprehensive spot welding dataset demonstrate the efficacy of our approach, showcasing significant improvements in detection accuracy and overall performance for resistance spot welding vision inspection.

articleTitle: Blockchain-Supported Platform for Collaborative Livestreaming of STEM Courses
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: With the rapid development and increasing maturity of emerging technologies such as 5G communication, artificial intelligence, blockchain technology, and computer supported collaborative work, the internet is entering a new era - Web3. This transformation brings both opportunities and challenges to the field of education. Addressing current issues faced by universities, such as security risks in resource storage, lack of platform creation incentives, complexity in copyright confirmation, unsatisfactory user interaction experiences, and insufficient supply of high-quality educational resources, this paper explores and proposes an innovative solution - the “CoTeach” smart education platform. This platform integrates the core concepts of Web3, and data-driven artificial intelligence technology. It aims to reshape the teaching and learning experience, as well as the collaborative development of professional knowledge. Specifically, the “CoTeach” platform ensures secure storage and immutability of educational resources through blockchain technology, reducing risks associated with resource storage. By utilizing collaborative livestreaming mechanisms, it provides economic incentives for creators, contributors, and learners, fostering greater community participation. The transparency and smart contract functionality of blockchain simplify the copyright confirmation process, safeguarding creators' rights. The platform enhances user interaction through gamification design, making the learning process more engaging and enjoyable. Finally, artificial intelligence technology optimizes resource recommendations and personalized learning paths, addressing the shortage of high-quality educational resources.

articleTitle: Barometric Altimeter Assisted SINS/DR Combined Land Vehicle Gravity Anomaly Method
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: Traditional land vehicle gravity measurement heavily rely on high-precision satellite navigation positioning information. However, the operational range of satellite navigation is limited, and it cannot maintain the required level of accuracy in special environments. To address this issue, we propose a novel land vehicle gravity anomaly measurement method based on altimeter-assisted strapdown inertial navigation system (SINS)/dead reckoning (DR) integration. Gravimetric measurement trials demonstrate that after low-pass filtering, the new method achieves a fit accuracy of 2.005 mGal, comparable to that of the traditional SINS/global navigation satellite system (GNSS) integration method. Compared with the SINS/DR integration method, the proposed method improves accuracy by approximately 11%.

articleTitle: Jointing High-State and Low-State Feature Reconstruction Networks and Discriminator Training for Track Anomaly Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: Railway safety inspections are critical to prevent catastrophic incidents, yet existing anomaly detection methods often suffer from insufficient sample data and overgeneralization. This paper proposes an improved anomaly detection method called HLFRN-D, which integrates dual-state feature reconstruction networks trained alongside a discriminator. HLFRN-D mitigates decoder overgeneralization by shifting the discriminator's focus from pixel-level abnormalities to evaluating the reconstruction performance of the networks. An anomaly generation module and a novel loss function further enhance robustness. Experimental results show that HLFRN-D achieves superior performance, with an AUROC score of 97.6% and PRO score of 94.4% on MVTec AD, and 99.3% AUROC and 97.7% PRO on track datasets, highlighting its effectiveness in detecting diverse anomaly types and locations.

articleTitle: Research on Aircraft Patrol Inspection Method Using UAV Based on YOLO Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: At present, the walk - around inspection of aircraft mainly adopts the manual walk-around method. This method is costly and inefficient, and is prone to human factors such as missed inspections and false inspections. Therefore, the research on intelligent appearance surface inspection methods is an urgent task. In this paper, through the collection and processing of aircraft exterior images, the YOLO algorithm is used to learn the key parts of the aircraft's around-the-aircraft inspection, and an aircraft exterior damage image data set is established. This method plans the drone's around-the-aircraft inspection flight route. The drone is used to transmit the real-time images of the aircraft taken during the flight back to the ground station. The ground station uses the YOLO algorithm to identify the damage types and degrees of the received images. This method can replace the method of mounting a high-performance computer on the unmanned aerial vehicle, reducing on-board equipment and improving the reliability of the system. The method proposed in this paper can solve some of the drawbacks of traditional manual visual inspection, and can provide a technical reference for the engineering application of robot-intelligent around-aircraft inspection, which is of great significance for reducing the maintenance and upkeep costs during the aircraft flight-test and operation stages.

articleTitle: A Study on Sentencing for Traffic Offences Based on the Decision Tree Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: Traffic offences are characterised by high complexity and low sentencing accuracy in the ordinary prosecution sentencing process. Decision tree algorithm is a more effective sentencing accuracy and high fairness of the intelligent prosecution sentencing tool. The algorithm analyses the sentencing situation by establishing a data mining model, analysing and data crawling a large number of cases and judgments. A data table of traffic offence features is established by keyword search and feature information extraction to form a jurisprudence database. Using python language and related tool libraries, the factors of the formation of traffic offence are considered comprehensively for sentencing prediction, which is used as an auxiliary tool for sentencing. Through the experiment for data collection and analysis, the data structure model and algorithm model are constructed, and the expansion analysis of the algorithm model is achieved to realise the intelligent sentencing process for traffic crime.

articleTitle: Design of Four Channels Waveform Generator Based on DDS
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: Direct digital frequency synthesis technology(DDS) has been developed for more than 50 years. It has been widely used in radar, communication, electronic countermeasures and other fields, because of its high frequency resolution, fast frequency conversion speed, continuous phase during frequency conversion, low output phase noise and the ability to generate arbitrary waveform. In this paper, we design a four channels waveform generator based on DDS for the current multi-source and multi array radar equipment, which can generate point frequency, LFM, NLFM and other signals; Within 430±100MHz bandwidth, its spurious suppression performance is better than - 70dBc, and the four channels can be switched freely to work synchronously or independently by FPGA. It is applicable to radar equipment with high requirements for waveform synchronization, such as multiple-input multiple-output radar, frequency diversity radar, multi-function radar, etc.

articleTitle: Computer Detection of Passives in Parallel Corpora
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: This research on passive voice is based on a corpus of 730 texts by the vocational college students in Shanghai and 190 essays excerpted from the LOCNESS corpus. The computer tools used to process the data include PatCount, AntConc, TreeTagger3, SPSS 20, and so on. Findings are made as follows: first, L1 speakers tend to use passives far more frequently than L2 learners, especially in progressive tense and perfect tense. Second, L1 speakers tend to use passives more often in present tense (3rd person singular) than L2 learners. Third, the writing proficiency of either L1 speaker or L2 learner is not necessarily correlated with the frequency of passive usages. Fourth, there are insignificant differences in passive usages between the writings of the vocational college students in China, compared with L1 speakers' writings. Fifth, L2 learners sometimes tend to use passives in past perfect tense. Finally, there are significant differences between L1 speakers' writings and L2 learners' writings in get-passive usage. In L1 speakers' writings, almost all the passive verbs are connected with unfavorable situation of the agent, whereas L2 learners' writings in the most frequently used verb phrase is “get used to”, expressing the habitual behavior of the agent.

articleTitle: Grape Leaf Disease Detection and Recognition Method Based on Improved Model RTDETR-DRA
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: In recent years, the rapid development of artificial intelligence has revolutionized agriculture, particularly in the detection and identification of plant diseases. Grape leaf diseases pose a significant threat to grape production, directly impacting yield and quality. To address the limitations of existing disease detection models, such as high computational cost and inefficient deployment on resource-limited devices, we propose an improved model based on RTDETR, named RTDETR-DRA. This model integrates the DRBNCSPELAN module, leveraging multi-path feature fusion and channel split design to optimize real-time detection accuracy while minimizing computational cost. Experimental results show that RTDETR-DRA outperforms the original RTDETR model, achieving higher accuracy in disease detection with significantly reduced parameters and GFLOPs, making it suitable for lightweight deployment on platforms like mobile devices. Our proposed method contributes to the advancement of efficient and precise plant disease detection technologies.

articleTitle: CLPSO: An Improved PSO Algorithm and its Application to PID Parameter Tuning
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: To address the issues of low efficiency and limited adaptability to complex operating conditions in traditional PID controller parameter tuning methods, this study proposes an enhanced particle swarm optimizer, CLPSO. This approach incorporates piecewise-based chaotic mapping for population initialization and an improved Levy flight mechanism to strengthen global search capabilities. The performance of CLPSO is evaluated on the CEC2021 test suite and applied to parameter tuning for PID controllers across five commonly encountered complex control systems. Results demonstrate that CLPSO achieves better search performance compared to standard PSO, with good improvements in PID parameter optimization.

articleTitle: Design of an Embedded Transcranial Pulse Electrical Stimulation System
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: This article provides an in-depth description of an advanced transcranial pulsed electrical stimulation (tPES) technique. The core of this technology lies in achieving precise transcranial pulsed electrical stimulation of 1 to 2 milliamperes, with a regulation accuracy of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\pm 2\%$</tex>. By constructing a closed circuit composed of positive and negative electrodes, the technology applies precisely controlled pulsed current to the brain. Combined with high-frequency pulse stimulation at 20 hertz, this technique aims to adjust the resting membrane potential of brain neurons, thereby achieving fine-tuned control of neuronal excitability, including activation or inhibition. Furthermore, the technology also has the capability to modulate synaptic connections between neurons, offering new research directions in the field of neural modulation.

articleTitle: Monocular Object Pose Estimation Using Specific Object Imaging Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: Estimating robust 6D object poses using RGB images under conditions of clutter or occlusion remains a challenging task. Existing methods typically either extract features from the entire scene or apply deep networks for feature extraction following object detection and semantic segmentation. However, these approaches can lead to incorrect learning, causing models to fail in accurately capturing the core characteristics of objects and resulting in errors when matching 2D images with 3D models. Furthermore, in complex and dynamic scenes, the detection performance of current methods still requires improvement, underscoring the need for further research and algorithm optimization. To address this issue, we propose a 6D pose estimation method based on specific object imaging. Our method actively and intelligently extracts image information of specific targets through object imaging, thereby avoiding global processing of the entire scene and significantly reducing the amount of irrelevant information processed. This enables the model to more accurately learn the complete feature information of target objects, achieving higher accuracy in complex and dynamic application scenarios. Experiments on the public LM-O dataset demonstrate that our method achieves significant improvements in the ADD(-S) metric compared to existing techniques.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Reliability Model in Electrical System
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: In the absence of system-level test information, the evaluation experience of system-level reliability mainly draws on the relevant reliability information of marine electronic equipment components and subsystems. Aiming at the problem of how to improve the reliability of different types of electronic equipment, this paper studies the use of reliability evaluation models and their selection methods and basic processes, including the selection and processes of unit product reliability evaluation models and complex system reliability evaluation models; Aiming at the reliability evaluation model of marine electronic equipment, this paper focuses on the breakthrough of the reliability evaluation model of marine electronic equipment based on small sample life information, the application of information fusion technology in the reliability evaluation model of marine electronic equipment complex system and the reliability evaluation method suitable for the truncated data of marine electronic equipment, so as to achieve the purpose of modeling and analyzing the reliability of marine electronic equipment.

articleTitle: Enhancing Medical Review Integrity and Privacy with Linkable Ring Signatures
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: In contemporary medical systems, the mechanism for medical reviews plays a crucial role in improving the quality of healthcare services. However, review systems face two critical challenges. On the one hand, doctors and hospitals exhibit a strong interest in the reviewers' identities, potentially deterring patients from providing genuine feedback due to concerns over identity exposure. On the other hand, some patients may excessively express their likes or dislikes through repeated comments, compromising the fairness of the review system. To address these issues, this paper introduces an anonymous medical review scheme based on Linkable Ring Signature (LRS) technology. By organizing patients treated during the same period into a signature ring, using the public key list and private key to construct the LRS's LinkTag, the scheme protects the privacy of reviewers while effectively preventing duplicate reviews. The paper thoroughly designs the system model and implementation process, including system initialization, patient registration, ring generation, review publication, and verification. Experimental evaluation demonstrates that the scheme balances computational efficiency, internal consumption, and storage overhead. The research outcomes provide a viable solution for constructing a medical evaluation system emphasizing privacy protection and review management.

articleTitle: Research on Small Sample Power Model for Transmission Inspection Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: When using small sample transfer learning to train models in the field of power inspection, the total amount of feature information in the small sample is insufficient, and the application scenarios adapted by the model before migration are often significantly different from the power business scenarios, resulting in underfitting and underfitting of the model trained by small sample transfer learning. This paper proposes a small sample power model for power transmission inspection based on improved deep transfer learning. It aims to address the challenges brought by small samples through transfer learning and generative adversarial networks (GAN) and other technologies. First, the generative adversarial network (GAN) is used to generate synthetic samples similar to the real data distribution to expand the data set size and improve the generalization ability of the model. Secondly, the pre-trained deep convolutional neural network (CNN) is used, combined with the attention mechanism, to automatically focus on the key areas in the power equipment to improve the accuracy and efficiency of defect detection. The pre-trained model is fine-tuned through transfer learning to adapt it to the specific field characteristics of power inspection, so as to achieve better detection performance with limited data. Experimental results show that the proposed method can effectively improve the detection accuracy of the small sample power inspection model and has high practical application value.

articleTitle: A 5.43 ppm/°C Bandgap Reference Based on High-Order Curvature Compensation
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: In this paper, a bandgap reference with a wide temperature range of -55°C~150°C and high accuracy and low temperature range is proposed. The reference is centered on the Brokaw bandgap reference structure, which utilizes V<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">BE</inf> Linearization compensation and piecewise-linear current-mode technique based on the current summation structure to reduce the temperature coefficient over the full temperature range. The circuit is realized based on a 0.18 μm BCD process, and the simulation results show that the bandgap reference outputs a reference voltage of 1.188 V at a supply voltage of 5 V, with a temperature drift coefficient of 5.84 ppm/°C over a temperature range of -55°C to 150°C.

articleTitle: ImprSORT: A Robust Multi-Object Tracker Based on Multiple Tracking Cues
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: Multi-object Tracking aims to detect and track all objects while maintaining the identity consistency of each object. Most methods leverage motion and appearance cues to accomplish this task, but these cues may become unreliable in crowded and non-linear motion scenarios. To address this issue, we propose a novel robust multi-object tracker called ImprSORT. By improving data association and tracking cues within the heuristic tracking method, ImprSORT maintains robust tracking performance in crowded and non-linear motion scenarios while preserving simplicity and online tracking capabilities. ImprSORT was evaluated on multiple datasets, including DanceTrack, MOT17, and MOT20, and achieved superior performance, demonstrating strong generalization across various scenarios. Notably, ImprSORT achieved the highest IDFl score on the DanceTrack dataset, where interactions and severe occlusions occur frequently.

articleTitle: Anti-Dynamic SSDF Attack Scheme Based on Credit Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: In order to mitigate the effects of multi-path fading and solve the hidden terminal problem, cooperative spectrum sensing (CSS) is seen as an effective method to improve detection accuracy. However, CSS systems are themselves vulnerable to attacks by malicious nodes, especially spectrum sensing data falsification (SSDF) attacks. These attacks can cause damage to its performance. Thus, a dynamic SSDF attack security scheme based on credit mechanism is proposed in this paper. The core of this scheme is that the fusion center uses beta reputation system to assign reputation values to secondary users (SUs) according to their current and historical sensing behavior. On this basis, a punishment scheme to modify reputation is designed. This overall strategy not only significantly reduces the interference of malicious behaviors on the decision-making process but also greatly enhances the fairness and robustness of the system, providing a more stable and reliable environment for CSS.

articleTitle: Key Technologies for Multi-Pathing in High-Reliability Multi-Controller Storage Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: Enterprise level applications have very strict requirements for the reliability of data storage. Multi control storage systems use redundant hardware to achieve high reliability of storage devices, while high reliability of transmission links needs to be guaranteed through multiple paths. A multipath technology family is proposed to address the issues of the inability of the operating system's built-in multipath software to optimize paths in conjunction with the multi control storage system, as well as the limited display of path information. This family utilizes logical unit number aggregation, path detection technology, path state adjustment technology, and path scaling technology to select and switch the optimal path for the multi control storage system, thereby achieving uninterrupted and high reliability of storage system services.

articleTitle: M3-Mixer:A Multimodal Mixer for Multimodal Sentiment Analysis with Multi-Head Loss
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: Multimodal Sentiment Analysis (MSA) often requires substantial computational resources to attain top-tier performance. Contemporary cutting-edge methods frequently rely on intricate processes, which entail considerable computational overhead. Recently, MLP (Multilayer Perceptron)-based approaches have achieved remarkable results, especially in computer vision. Drawing inspiration from these successes, we present M3-Mixer-a framework derived from the MLP-Mixer model and employing multi-head loss. M3-Mixer stands out due to its straightforward design and improved computational efficiency. Specifically, M3-Mixer uses text as a guide to split the model into two branches, each containing three independent MLP modules. These MLP modules exchange information across three directions: sequence, modality, and channel. Each module comprises two fully connected layers, an activation functions, and a skip connection. We evaluate M3-Mixer on two sentiment analysis datasets, CMU-MOSI and CMU-MOSEI. The results demonstrate that M3-Mixer achieves competitive performance with significantly lower computational cost.

articleTitle: Leveraging Self-Supervised Learning for Enhanced Image Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: This study investigates the effectiveness of self-supervised learning (SSL) strategies, including SimCLR and MoCo, in image classification tasks, with a focus on large-scale datasets such as ImageNet. We evaluate SSL methods using varying proportions of labeled data on ImageNet and compare their performance to traditional supervised learning models such as AlexNet and VGG16. Experimental results show that the combination of SimCLR with Vision Transformer (ViT) achieved a Top-1 accuracy of 78.5%, surpassing SimCLR with ResNet (76.3%) and MoCo with ViT (77.3%), demonstrating superior generalization on ImageNet. Hyperparameter tuning, including adjustments to batch size, learning rate, and temperature, significantly improved model performance, resulting in more stable loss curves. Feature visualization using t-SNE further demonstrated that SSL models like SimCLR and MoCo achieved better class separation and intra-class cohesion than traditional supervised learning models. Computational cost analysis revealed that while ViT provided superior performance, its high computational demands make it less feasible in resource-limited environments. In contrast, SimCLR showed more computational efficiency, making it preferable for large-scale datasets. These findings highlight the scalability and robustness of SSL methods, suggesting that future work should focus on optimizing SSL for class-imbalanced datasets and exploring more efficient architectures for real-world applications.

articleTitle: Application of Machine Learning Based Life Prediction Method in Aviation Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: In order to quickly predict the life indicators of aircraft wires, a modeling and parameter estimation method based on different surrogate models is proposed for aircraft wires. The predicted values are used to predict the full cycle life and reliable life of aircraft wires during their service period through finite difference method, determine the working life of the product, and achieve vibration in the high vibration zone of the aircraft tail.

articleTitle: Segment Routing Algorithm for Mega LEO Constellations
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: Against the backdrop of limited transmission resources, high latency, and diverse transmission service types within mega LEO constellation space networks, this paper proposes a segment routing algorithm tailored for mega LEO constellations. In this algorithm, the application-aware module at the satellite head node collects application-specific information, while the route calculation module employs the quadrant method to filter and compute satellite segment nodes, ultimately generating an IP packet with a path label stack. The algorithm dynamically adjusts the routing path based on various application data, optimizes QoS guarantees for routing, supports the selection of satellite segment nodes in segment routing, and effectively enhances system throughput while reducing packet loss. Simulation results indicate that the proposed routing algorithm outperforms others in latency, packet loss rate, and throughput within mega LEO constellations.

articleTitle: Evaluation Study of a Semantic Understanding Platform for Smart Customer Service in the Power Industry
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: This study employs a gradient fuzzy number and object-element topology computational model to evaluate the semantic understanding platforms used in intelligent power customer service. First, the indicators of these platforms are quantified using gradient fuzzy numbers to address uncertainties and ambiguities inherent in the evaluation process. Next, an evaluation index system for these platforms is established based on the object-element topology model, allowing for an in-depth analysis of the relative importance of various performance indicators. This analysis is then used to assess the overall platform performance. Finally, real-world data and experimental analysis are employed to derive the weight rankings of the indicators, validating the model's effectiveness and reliability. The findings presented in this paper not only provide a robust framework for evaluating semantic understanding platforms in the electric power sector but also offer valuable theoretical insights and practical recommendations for similar projects.

articleTitle: Design of a New Underwater Acoustic Communication Transmission Scheme Based on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: In view of the current situation that underwater acoustic spread spectrum communication can store and send a small number of code segments, this paper designs and implements a new underwater acoustic communication transmission scheme based on FPGA. This scheme can effectively store and send a large number of spread spectrum code segments, and can change the transmission frame structure at any time, with portability and upgradeability. The use of 16-bit precision AD5541 as the digital-to-analog conversion chip has changed the previous storage and transmission methods of code segments, greatly reducing the consumption of storage space, and can store more code segments. This scheme uses the w5500 network chip to communicate with the host computer. The host computer software is developed using app designer, and can choose to send code segments. Finally, this scheme was tested under laboratory conditions and can store and send 1024 code segments. The code and project of this scheme have been uploaded to https://github.com/yeb1010/ad5541_driver.

articleTitle: Segment Planning of Multiple Escape Paths in Different Narrow Passage Scenarios
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: The escape problem in autonomous driving means that the robot will enter the escape mode when it detects that there is an obstacle ahead and it cannot pass safely according to the planned route. At this point, the robot needs to re-plan its route, so the escape path planning problem aims to find a path that can get out of the current predicament and return to the expected trajectory. In this paper, we propose a planning method for solving escape paths in complex scenarios. First of all, this method greatly improves the search efficiency of hybrid A* and avoids some redundant node expansion. Secondly, this method improves the availability of paths on narrow roads while ensuring search efficiency, and does not cause paths to be inaccessible due to space limitations of narrow roads. Finally, the splicing method between each path segment is proposed. Compared with traditional escape path planning methods, the cost of our planning solution is reduced by more than 85%.

articleTitle: Design of an Intelligent Asset Recovery System Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: The increasing complexity of financial crimes poses significant challenges for traditional asset recovery methods, which often fail to effectively trace covert fund transfers and complex money laundering schemes. To address these limitations, this paper proposes and implements an intelligent asset recovery system based on deep learning, incorporating advanced computational techniques to enhance the detection and analysis of complex financial transactions. The system utilizes a hybrid CNN-LSTM model to extract both spatial and temporal features from transaction data, while a self-attention mechanism dynamically highlights critical transaction patterns, improving the model's interpretability and recognition capabilities. A multimodal data fusion approach integrates diverse sources, including bank transaction records, social network data, and public financial statements, enabling comprehensive analysis of heterogeneous data. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed system significantly outperforms traditional methods in key metrics, achieving higher accuracy, precision, recall, and Fl scores. Moreover, it exhibits superior performance in identifying intricate fund transfer chains and adapting to diverse financial crime scenarios. The study not only provides a robust, automated tool for asset recovery but also establishes a foundation for the development of intelligent systems aimed at preventing and combating financial crimes. Future research will focus on enhancing system scalability, optimizing computational efficiency, and integrating additional data sources to further expand its application scope.

articleTitle: Image Fusion Based on Gradient Domain
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: Hyperspectral images, due to their rich spectral information, are widely used in precision agriculture, military object recognition, and ground object surveying. However, due to the physical limitations of imaging sensors, it is often necessary to apply image fusion techniques to extract and combine different spectral bands, thus obtaining images more suitable for practical applications[1]. For instance, RGB-NIR (Red, Green, Blue, and Near Infrared) image fusion is a commonly used method. Near-infrared images play a crucial role in applications like night vision and fog imaging. By fully leveraging the advantages of both visible light and infrared images while mitigating their shortcomings, it is possible to retain as much useful information as possible in a single image, bringing the results closer to real-world applications. This paper aims to improve the performance of multispectral image fusion, focusing on producing images with more detailed features and natural colors. Using this algorithm, we first generate the desired fused image gradient matrix based on the existing Spectral Edge (SpE) image fusion method. Then, a gradient-domain-based image reconstruction algorithm that optimizes gradient constraints and matrix operations to rebuild the fused image is constructed. We also test the proposed algorithm using the RGB and NIR image dataset from the experimental fields of Shenyang Agricultural University and compare the results with the original SpE algorithm. The experimental results demonstrate that the proposed algorithm enhances the image details and avoids color distortion, outperforming the SpE method both subjectively and in quantitative metrics.

articleTitle: Near-Earth Space Target Tracking Based on Unscented Kalman Filter
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that it is difficult to accurately capture the target position information when tracking the target because of the fast motion speed of near-Earth spatial targets and the complex observation background, this paper proposes a near-Earth spatial target tracking method based on the Unscented Kalman Filter. The study establishes a kinematic model of space target considering system noise and designs the flow of near-Earth space target tracking algorithm. The experimental results show that all the evaluation indexes meet the expected requirements of the design, and its experimental effect is improved compared with the Kalman filtering method. The method of this paper has a fast program running rate, high target tracking efficiency, strong applicability, good real-time performance, and has a good use value and prospects for wide application.

articleTitle: Design of Intelligent Warehouse Management System
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: The intelligent shelf management system is designed to achieve real-time monitoring and management of goods on the shelf through the Internet of Things, sensor network and Internet technology. This paper proposes a multi-shelf intelligent storage system, which can automatically identify and track inventory changes, optimize replenishment process and realize data interaction. The system adopts STM32 main control chip, which can collect material weight information efficiently. After data processing, it can be uploaded to the server through the network interface to ensure the timeliness and accuracy of data. At the same time, the system has designed a series of protection and convenience measures, so that users can fully grasp and process the shelf information, and improve management efficiency. After testing in a complex factory environment, the system shows excellent stability, can stably collect data and effectively issue user commands to meet the needs of users for smart containers. The research not only provides an innovative solution for intelligent warehousing, but also provides an important reference for the digital transformation of related industries.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of an Ultrasonic Audio Jamming System
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: This paper details the design and implementation of an audio jamming system intended to protect against unauthorized recordings. The system integrates an ultrasonic jamming signal generator, an audio signal recognition module, and a control module. Addressing the increasing risk of illicit recordings brought about by ubiquitous recording devices, the system employs ultrasonic jamming technology to disrupt the functionality of recording devices while minimally affecting normal communication. Utilizing STM32F429 as the core controller, the system precisely adjusts the output power of ultrasonic signals through PWM modulation. Rigorous testing demonstrates that the system can effectively jam recording devices within a range of 6 meters, with minimal impact on normal audio communication. The proposed solution exhibits robust performance and is well-suited for privacy-sensitive scenarios such as meetings and commercial negotiations.

articleTitle: Modeling of a High Precision Continuous Time Sigma Delta Modulator
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: Sigma-Delta ADC architecture is usually adopted in high precision ADCs. This paper presents a sigma delta modulator (SDM) model based on a single loop feedforward and feedback topology (CIFF-B), a single bit quantization, and a FIR feedback DAC. The different structures of Sigma-Delta modulator are studied using Simulink and non-ideal factors are concerned. Considering the impact of clock jitter on continuous time Sigma Delta modulators, FIR filter is added to the feedback DAC. In this paper, the system structure of the modulator adopts the pulse invariant transformation method, and the system design parameters are obtained by modeling the non-ideal factors such as clock jitter, the irrational factor of the amplifier and the clock delay. The simulation results of the proposed SDM model achieve 22.68bit of significant bits (ENOB) with 5.12MHz sample frequency.

articleTitle: YOLO-Steel: An Enhanced Detection Model for Steel Surface Defects
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: Due to imperfections in the manufacturing process and the influence of external factors, steel surfaces often exhibit defects that can seriously affect their lifespan and usability. Surface defect detection is a crucial process in industrial production, but traditional detection algorithms suffer from low accuracy and slow speed. To address these issues, this paper proposes a detection algorithm based on an improved YOLOv8n model, named YOLO-Steel. This research focuses on improvements in two aspects: feature extraction and feature fusion. In terms of feature extraction, considering the strong background noise interference and complex shapes of steel surface defects, the EMA attention mechanism module is introduced to enhance the extraction capability of both shallow and deep feature information. For feature fusion, the embedded asymptotic feature pyramid network (AFPN) is incorporated to improve the feature fusion process, enabling direct interaction between non-adjacent layers and effectively mitigating semantic gaps. Multiple experiments conducted on the NEU-DET dataset show that the improved YOLO-Steel model increases mAP50 by 5.4% and reduces GFLOPs by 5.6% compared to the original model, demonstrating superior defect localization and recognition capabilities, while meeting the speed requirements for industrial applications.

articleTitle: Measurement Uncertainty Evaluation of BCI Immunity Based on Automotive Electrical/Electronic
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: Disturbances from narrowband radiated electromagnetic energy Current Injection (BCI) is a crucial EMC test; the test results should be given, including the measurement uncertainty. When providing the assigned severity level of the experiment, the corresponding measurement uncertainty must also be provided. This paper evaluates the measurement uncertainty of the BCI test in ISO 11452–4. By analyzing the sources of uncertainty, they establish a mathematical model and quantify the influencing factors, provide reasonable evaluation results, and propose methods to reduce uncertainty in the experimental process.

articleTitle: Cocotb-Based Verification of Multi-Protocol Interconnection Network
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: The pervasive applications of multi-core processors and specialized hardware accelerator in system-on-chip (SoC) designs has led to a growing complexity in on-chip interconnection networks, particularly in the context of multi-host arbitration and multi-protocol communication, which present a multitude of challenges. This paper presents a verification scheme for multi-protocol interconnection networks based on the AMBA protocol and demonstrates the use of the open-source Python verification framework cocotb. The flexible concatenation mechanism and extensive open-source support of cocotb enable efficient verification of complex requirements under multiple protocols, including AXI, AHB, APB, and others. We concentrate on testing the fundamental operations, including cross-clock domain transmission, arbitration mechanisms, and protocol conversion, by verifying a multi-master interconnection that supports multiple protocols. The experimental outcomes demonstrate that cocotb has effective function verification capabilities and offers a novel approach to the verification of SoC interconnection networks.

articleTitle: Optimized Operation Model of Electro-Hydrogen System Based on Improved Meta-Heuristic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: With the increase of clean energy demand, the electro-hydrogen coupling system has gradually become an important way to achieve energy structure optimization due to its potential in power peak shaving, energy storage and fluctuating supply and demand balance. Traditional optimization methods are usually difficult to solve effectively in multi-objective and multi-constraint electro-hydrogen systems, and it is easy to fall into local optimums and slow convergence speeds. In this paper, an optimized operation method of electro-hydrogen coupling system based on improved sparrow search algorithm is proposed. In this paper, the standard sparrow search algorithm is improved by introducing Sinusoidal chaos initialization, information sharing factor and random walk strategy, and the global search ability and local optimization efficiency of the algorithm are enhanced. The improved algorithm excels at the goals of minimizing costs, maximizing energy efficiency, and minimizing carbon emissions. Simulation results show that compared with traditional algorithms, the proposed method has significant advantages in convergence speed, solution distribution and energy efficiency of system operation.

articleTitle: A 32 Gb/s Cascade High-Compensation Hybrid CTLE Receiver With Adaptive Equalization in 12-nm FinFET
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: This paper proposes a novel 32Gb/<tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$s$</tex> high-compensation hybrid five-stage stochastic continuous-time linear equalizer (CTLE) adaptation receiver for a 12-nm FinFET process. The innovative stochastic CTLE receiver, featuring a mid-frequency peaking structure, effectively addresses issues related to signal transmission characteristics, such as intersymbol interference (ISI). An attenuator (ATT) within the five-stage cascade circuit establishes a feedback system for the control system's common mode points, enabling low-frequency attenuation and effective modulation of low-frequency signals. Furthermore, a gain-tuning scheme combining ATT and CTLE is proposed and analyzed. This scheme implements a multi-stage equalizer with an adaptive equalization loop, providing a maximum peak gain between 35.45dB and 44.41dB at the Nyquist frequency. In comparison to other receivers of similar nature, this CTLE receiver exhibits a 32% enhancement in gain performance, achieving maximum horizontal eye margin. It boasts an adaptive convergence time of 3.3 μs and a total power consumption of 13.5 mW, all within an overall layout area of 0.01 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>,

articleTitle: Secure QoS Requirements of V2V Underlay Cellular Networks: A Interference Utilization Method
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: The underlay mode of spectrum allocation in vehicle-to-vehicle (V2V) communication link is widely used in cellular vehicular network, which can improve spectrum utilization by allowing V2V users to share the resources of cellular users. The traditional method is to weaken or eliminate the impact of interference, but this paper considers from the perspective of physical layer security, in the presence of eavesdropping users, the interference generated by multiplexing between V2V links and cellular users is used to suppress eavesdropping, so as to improve the security of cellular communication. To this end, we study the resource allocation problem to maximize the secrecy capacity of cellular users while ensuring the reliability of each V2V link.

articleTitle: An Efficient Accelerator for MobileNet with Dual-Strategy Data Reuse and Unified Computing Engine
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: Deploying convolutional neural networks in edge devices is an important trend. This paper introduces an FPGA-based MobileNet inference accelerator for high energy efficiency. It meets the specific computational needs of MobileNet's depthwise and pointwise convolutions with dual data reuse strategies. A unified computing engine is designed for efficient convolution computation, maximizing hardware utilization. Our accelerator, tested on Xilinx XCKU035, achieves a 90.68% PE utilization rate with MobileNetV2, with a DSP efficiency of 0.41 FPS/DSP, outperforming recent accelerators. It consumes 1.415W, with each frame using only 35.55mJ, showing 3x improvements over GPU. This design is expected to provide considerable advantages in edge computing.

articleTitle: LiteStereo: A Lightweight 4D Cost Volume Network for Accurate Stereo Matching
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: Stereo matching is essential in applications like localization, 3D reconstruction, and autonomous driving. In stereo matching, the construction and aggregation of cost volume are crucial pipelines. However, previous methods suffer from redundant features in the 4D cost volume and ineffective aggregation, resulting in low matching accuracy in texture-less areas. We introduce LiteStereo, a method designed to enhance cost volume construction and aggregation. Specifically, LiteStereo builds a lightweight 4D cost volume by reducing redundant low-frequency features and compressing important channels. Then a series of 3D convolutions are introduced to better regularize the 4D cost volume. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed LiteStereo improves matching accuracy in fine structures, surpassing RAFTstereo by 11.1% on the Noc-3px metric of the KITTI2012.

articleTitle: Research on Point Cloud Classification for Transmission Channel Based on Improved PointMLP
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: The airborne LiDAR point cloud of transmission lines plays an important role in the safe operation and maintenance of power transmission lines. This paper proposes a point cloud classification method for transmission channels based on an improved PointMLP network, targeting the surface features of different types of objects such as power towers, power lines, vegetation, and buildings within the transmission channels. Firstly, At the point cloud input end, hyper voxel seed voxel optimization is introduced to better classify tower bottoms, vegetation, and buildings with complex environments.Secondly, efficient multiscale attention EMA is introduced to reduce the interference of low-density vegetation on the classification of transmission line tower bottoms. Finally, replace the loss function with the point cloud loss function Chamfer Distance to reduce the excessive penalty of geometric factors and improve the performance of the model regression. The experimental results show that the algorithm proposed in the paper has a certain performance improvement compared to PointNet++and PintMLP algorithms.

articleTitle: Infrared Image Human Detection Based on Improved RT-DETR Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: This study presents a novel approach for human detection in infrared images by enhancing the RT-DETR algorithm. The aim is to overcome challenges related to low detection accuracy and real-time performance issues in infrared target detection. The proposed method involves replacing the original RT-DETR algorithm's backbone network with ConvNeXt to improve feature extraction capabilities for low-resolution infrared images. Additionally, a Feature Pyramid Network (FPN) is incorporated to facilitate multi-scale feature fusion, thereby enhancing small target detection accuracy. Furthermore, optimization of the detection head and the replacement of GIoU loss with CIoU loss are carried out to enhance bounding box localization precision. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method achieves higher mean Average Precision (mAP) and precision on the Teledyne FLIR ADAS infrared dataset. This improvement effectively balances inference time and real-time performance, offering an efficient solution for human detection in infrared images suitable for practical applications.

articleTitle: Multi-Layer Magnetic Shielding Design for TMR-Based Direct Current Sensors
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: In the development of a direct current sensor leveraging the tunneling magnetoresistance (TMR) effect, it is imperative to implement magnetic shielding to mitigate the impact of external magnetic interference and to safeguard the sensor's detection capabilities. To tackle the challenges posed by strong, persistent static magnetic interferences that exhibit significant variations in intensity, this study introduces a multi-tiered magnetic shielding system. This system comprises an inner U-shaped layer and an outer closed layer, designed to offer a progressive level of resistance against magnetic disturbances for the TMR sensor. The inner U-shaped layer of the shielding system is engineered to reshape the magnetic flux lines of the current under measurement, thereby enhancing the measurement precision along the TMR's magnetic sensitivity axis and delivering initial magnetic shielding. The outer closed layer acts as a protective shield, further bolstering the sensor's resilience against static magnetic interference. Through simulations, the materials and structural parameters for each layer of the shielding have been meticulously optimized. Subsequent to these simulations, physical prototypes were fabricated. Experimental validation has confirmed that the proposed magnetic shielding system enables a TMR sensor, with a rated measurement range of 300A, to achieve precise and stable current measurements even in the presence of intense static magnetic interference fields up to 200mT, with an error margin of less than 100mA. This research contributes valuable insights for the comprehensive design and fabrication of TMR sensors that are capable of operating reliably in complex electromagnetic environments.

articleTitle: Physical Modeling and Thermal Characterization of Multi-Finger GaN HEMTs
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: The electrical performance and reliability of gallium nitride (GaN) high electron mobility transistors (HEMTs) are significantly affected by the self-heating effect, whose severity is quantified by thermal resistance <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$(R_{th})$</tex>. This paper combines a 2D TCAD electrothermal physical model and a 3D finite element thermal model, considering the bias correlation of the heat source model. An iterative algorithm for multi-finger electrothermal coupling is proposed to improve the accuracy of the <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$R_{th}$</tex> extraction. The results reveal that the difference between optimized model and the conventional thermal model is 14.3%, and the optimized thermal model is verified by infrared (IR) thermography within 5% of error. Furthermore, a third-order RC thermal sub-network model is developed and validated to characterize the transient thermal response of the device based on the transient pulse current response, and the prediction error of the model is within 5mA/mm under different bias conditions. The full-flow thermal characterization method of the device proposed in this paper is an important reference for thermal evaluation, thermal optimization, and thermal design of GaN HEMTs.

articleTitle: Research on Air Quality Prediction Model Based on CEEMDAN-CNN-BiGRU-Attention
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: Air pollution has become a global environmental challenge, significantly impacting human health and ecosystem stability. Accurate air quality forecasting is essential for effective pollution control and public safety. This study proposes a novel hybrid forecasting model, CEEMDAN-CNN-BiGRU-Attention, to improve air quality prediction accuracy. The model integrates Complementary Ensemble Empirical Mode Decomposition with Adaptive Noise (CEEMDAN) to decompose the original time series into multiple Intrinsic Mode Functions (IMFs) with distinct frequency patterns. The decomposed IMFs are processed using a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) to capture local spatial dependencies. Further, a Bidirectional Gated Recurrent Unit (BiGRU) is employed to handle the temporal dependencies from both forward and backward directions, enhancing the model's ability to learn complex patterns in time series data. An Attention mechanism is incorporated to dynamically assign weights to the time steps, ensuring that the model emphasizes the most relevant information for forecasting. Comparative analysis with benchmark models such as ARIMA, LSTM, CNN-BiGRU, and CEEMDAN-BiGRU demonstrates the superiority of the proposed model in terms of both accuracy and generalization. The results indicate that the CEEMDAN-CNN-BiGRU-Attention model effectively captures the nonlinear, non-stationary characteristics of air quality data, providing more reliable forecasts.

articleTitle: LSTM-BP Model: Enhancing Prediction Accuracy for Medium Earth Orbit Satellites
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: To improve the low accuracy of the SGP4 model in short-term orbit prediction for medium Earth orbit satellites and the instability in LSTM model training, this paper proposes and develops an LSTM-BP prediction model. Compared to the SGP4 model, the LSTM model enhances the learning of historical data, better handling long-term dependencies and improving the model's representation capability and accuracy. The LSTM-BP model not only increases prediction accuracy but also mitigates the gradient instability issue in LSTM models to some extent. The model has been validated through several sets of generalization experiments, with a significant reduction in error following corrections. For example, along the X-axis, the maximum absolute error decreased from 54.9795 km to 2.3821 km.

articleTitle: Research on Wireless Communication Optimization Based on Edge Computation
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: The exponential growth of the number of Internet of Things (IoT) devices is placing significant strain on traditional wireless communication networks, particularly in terms of bandwidth, latency, and energy consumption. As a distributed computing architecture, edge computing enables the consolidation of computing resources at the user's edge, thereby alleviating the burden on the central server and reducing data transmission latency. This paper introduces a multi-level edge computing architecture, implements dynamic resource scheduling and collaborative computing strategies among edge nodes, and employs distributed computing methods to reasonably allocate computing tasks to different nodes, thereby addressing complex network scenarios. Additionally, the model incorporates a resource allocation algorithm based on deep reinforcement learning, which enables adaptive adjustments to bandwidth, computing resources, and communication paths. This results in optimal resource scheduling under varying network loads, markedly enhancing transmission efficiency and overall system performance in edge computing environments. In the experimental phase, the proposed model was validated using a simulation platform. The results demonstrated that the proposed model exhibited notable enhancements in data transmission delay, energy consumption, and throughput compared to the traditional method.

articleTitle: A Method for Implementing Function Reordering in GNU ld
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: This paper aims to implement function reordering in the GNU ld linker to improve program execution efficiency. The approach begins by adding the -ffunction-sections parameter during the GCC compilation phase, which places each function in its own section, laying the groundwork for subsequent layout adjustments. During the linking phase, the input files are traversed to parse the section nodes related to functions, particularly the statement_list nodes containing the various functions. Finally, by sorting and adjusting the statement_list nodes, the layout of functions in the executable file is made more aligned with actual call relationships, thereby reducing cache misses and the overhead caused by swapping in and out. Experimental results show that the function reordering feature in the linking phase increases program IPC by 1.116%, improves L1 cache hit rate by 1.625%, and reduces overall execution time by 2.888%. This method significantly enhances program performance by optimizing function layout, demonstrating the feasibility and effectiveness of implementing function reordering in GNU ld.

articleTitle: Investigation on the Radiation Emission Characteristics of Printed Circuit Boards with Integrated Isolation Chip
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: Isolation technology is widely used in high-low voltage transformation and long-distance transmission to effectively improve the reliability of the system. However, the imperfect design of the transformer inside the isolation chip may lead to an interference path between the primary and secondary coils of the transformer, which causes radiation emission. Accordingly, in this current work, the radiation emission characteristic of the printed circuit board (PCB) was investigated by simulation analysis and experimental tests. The main radiation sources in isolation chip were extracted, and the electromagnetic interference (EMI) radiation model was developed in electromagnetic simulation software to analyze the maximum radiation intensity of the PCB. A series of experimental tests are conducted to validate the electromagnetic field model. The results of this study provide a better understanding of the radiation emission characteristic of isolation chips and theorical support for improving the electromagnetic compatibility in the electronic system.

articleTitle: An Advertising Click through Rate Estimation Model AGCN that Integrates Temporal Information and Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: Click-through rate (CTR) prediction is essential for optimizing ad targeting and enhancing personalized user experiences. Accurate CTR prediction improves ad relevance, boosts user engagement, and increases revenue. However, CTR prediction faces challenges in capturing dynamic user interests and complex feature interactions. This paper introduces a new model, the Attention-Gated Cross Network (AGCN), which combines the Deep & Cross Network (DCN) and Gated Recurrent Unit (GRU) in a parallel structure to simultaneously handle feature interaction and user interest modeling. An attention mechanism within the GRU enhances user interest selection, assigning higher weights to behaviors more relevant to the target ad, thereby improving prediction accuracy.

articleTitle: Design of Upper Computer Detection System for Vibration Parameters of Mechanical Equipment
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: With the increasing development of modern equipment, data collection and real-time display of mechanical equipment are becoming more and more widespread. This article uses Visual Basic software to design a mechanical equipment vibration parameter upper computer detection system. The system interface design layout and underlying software design are described in detail. Through system software debugging, vibration data display and waveform drawing are realized, and vibration amplitude and frequency measurement are also achieved, which has certain practical value.

articleTitle: A Cross-Modal Alignment Method Based on Adaptive Feature Aggregation and Spatial Fusion Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
abstract: Multimodal tasks, such as vision-language integration, require efficient and adaptive frameworks to address challenges like feature imbalance, high computational cost, and cross-modal representation alignment. In this paper, we propose a novel framework that combines a lightweight cross-modal Transformer with an adaptive feature aggregation strategy to enhance multimodal feature integration capabilities. The proposed method includes a cross-modal adapter for feature alignment, an adaptive feature aggregation module to balance modality-specific feature representations, and a spatial adaptive fusion mechanism for optimized information extraction. Experiments on benchmark datasets demonstrate that the proposed framework achieves competitive performance in both zero-shot and fine-tuning scenarios for vision-language tasks. This study highlights the potential of adaptive cross-modal approaches in scalable, robust, and computationally efficient multimodal applications.

articleTitle: UIS Characterization of MOSFET Devices
publicationTitle: 2024 4th International Conference on Electronic Information Engineering and Computer (EIECT)
